````markdown
  local release="sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-$1" cj file="k8s-sea/sentio-network-devnet2/sentio-node-indexer-$1-storage-integrity-si-v2.yaml"
  cj="$(si_p1_cronjob "$1")" || return 2
  [ ! -e "$si_backup/si-backup-$1-commit" ] || { echo "si-backup-$1-commit exists: this step ran; never re-run it" >&2; return 1; }
  si_head_is charts/storage-integrity/tests/test_render.py "$file" || return 1
  si_p1_schedule_clear "$1" || return 1
  si_p1_tests "si-backup-$1-apply" || return 1
  si_render_diff "$release" > "$si_backup/render-si-backup-$1.txt" || return 1
  [ "$(cat "$si_backup/render-si-backup-$1.txt")" = "$(printf 'added ConfigMap/%s\nadded CronJob/%s' "$cj" "$cj")" ] || { cat "$si_backup/render-si-backup-$1.txt" >&2; echo "the commit renders something else than the CronJob and its ConfigMap: stop" >&2; return 1; }
  git rev-parse HEAD > "$si_backup/si-backup-$1-commit" || return 1
  git push origin HEAD:main || return 1
  helmfile -f k8s-sea/sentio-network-devnet2/storage-integrity-si-v2.helmfile.yaml sync --selector "name=$release" || return 1
  si_kubectl get cronjob "$cj" -o json > "$si_backup/cronjob-$1.json" || return 1
  si_kubectl get configmap "$cj" -o 'go-template={{index .data "config.yaml"}}' > "$si_backup/cronjob-$1-config.yaml" || return 1
  si_p1_py cronjob-check "$si_backup/cronjob-$1.json" "$si_backup/cronjob-$1-config.yaml" "$(si_p1_owner "$1")" "$(si_p1_installation "$1")" "$(si_p1_image)" || return 1
  si_p1_pods_check "$1" si-backup-job || return 1
}
si_p1_job_line() { # $1 format (si-backup-index-v1 | si-restore-drill-v1), $2 log file: the one line of the log that is a JSON object of that format
  si_p1_py job-line "$1" "$2"
}
si_backup_run() { # $1 a|b|c, $2 n: mutating (only in a confirmed block): one manual run of that owner's backup CronJob as Job <cronjob>-p1-<n>, waited for up to 70 minutes; records the owner's latest index before it (backup-<x>-<n>.prev, .prev.json; unknown once §13 removed the staging installation, which reads the bucket), saves the run's index line to backup-<x>-<n>.json and its log, once proven free of the owner's key, to backup-<x>-<n>.log
  local cj job s="" i hits
  cj="$(si_p1_cronjob "$1")" || return 2
  [[ "$2" =~ ^[1-9][0-9]*$ ]] || { echo "si_backup_run: n is a positive integer" >&2; return 2; }
  job="$cj-p1-$2"
  [ ! -e "$si_backup/backup-$1-$2.json" ] || { echo "backup-$1-$2.json exists: run $2 of indexer-$1 is done; never re-run it" >&2; return 1; }
  [ -z "$(si_kubectl get job "$job" --ignore-not-found -o name)" ] || { echo "Job $job exists: read it (§15.2) instead of creating it again" >&2; return 1; }
  si_p1_schedule_clear "$1" || return 1
  if [ -n "$(si_kubectl get pod "$si_p1s_pod" --ignore-not-found -o name)" ]; then
    si_indexes "$1" | tail -n 1 > "$si_backup/backup-$1-$2.prev" || return 1
    if [ -s "$si_backup/backup-$1-$2.prev" ]; then si_index "$1" "$(cat "$si_backup/backup-$1-$2.prev")" > "$si_backup/backup-$1-$2.prev.json" || return 1; fi
  else
    echo unknown > "$si_backup/backup-$1-$2.prev"
  fi
  si_kubectl create job --from="cronjob/$cj" "$job" || return 1
  for i in $(seq 1 420); do
    s="$(si_kubectl get job "$job" -o jsonpath='{.status.succeeded}/{.status.failed}')" || s=""
    case "$s" in 1/*|*/[1-9]*) break ;; esac
    sleep 10
  done
  hits="$(si_kubectl logs "job/$job" | si_secret_hits "backup-$(si_p1_owner "$1")")" || hits=unknown
  if [ "$hits" = 0 ]; then si_kubectl logs "job/$job" > "$si_backup/backup-$1-$2.log" 2>&1 || true; else echo "the log of Job $job holds the owner's key ($hits lines) or could not be read: it is not saved; rotate the key (§15.3)" >&2; return 1; fi
  case "$s" in 1/*) ;; *) echo "Job $job did not succeed (succeeded/failed: ${s:-unknown}): read $si_backup/backup-$1-$2.log and §15.2" >&2; return 1 ;; esac
  si_p1_job_line si-backup-index-v1 "$si_backup/backup-$1-$2.log" > "$si_backup/backup-$1-$2.json" || { rm -f "$si_backup/backup-$1-$2.json"; return 1; }
  cat "$si_backup/backup-$1-$2.json"
}
si_p1_backup_check() { # $1 a|b|c, $2 n: read-only: backup-<x>-<n>.json is a full backup when the owner had none before the run, else an incremental one on the latest index before it; its index object in the bucket is the same; the owner's ClickHouse lists the backup as created; its manifest entry is published and its tables hold the owner's known table; writes backup-check-<x>-<n>.txt
  local owner name prev=""
  owner="$(si_p1_owner "$1")" || return 2
  [ -s "$si_backup/backup-$1-$2.json" ] || { echo "no backup-$1-$2.json: run si_backup_run $1 $2 first" >&2; return 1; }
  [ -e "$si_backup/backup-$1-$2.prev" ] && [ "$(cat "$si_backup/backup-$1-$2.prev")" != unknown ] || { echo "no backup-$1-$2.prev of a run with the staging installation up: si_backup_run records it during P1" >&2; return 1; }
  [ ! -s "$si_backup/backup-$1-$2.prev" ] || prev="$si_backup/backup-$1-$2.prev.json"
  name="$(jq -r .name "$si_backup/backup-$1-$2.json")"
  {
    si_p1_py index-check "$si_backup/backup-$1-$2.json" "$owner" "$(cat "$si_backup/expected-table-$1")" ${prev:+"$prev"}
    si_index "$1" "$name" > "$si_backup/index-$1-$2.json"
    si_p1_py same-json "$si_backup/backup-$1-$2.json" "$si_backup/index-$1-$2.json"
    echo "bucket: $(si_indexes "$1" | tr '\n' ' ')"
    echo "owner ClickHouse: $(si_source_ch "$1" "SELECT status FROM system.backups WHERE position(name, '/owner-$owner/$name/') > 0 FORMAT TSV" | tr '\n' ' ')"
    si_track "$owner" | jq -c --slurpfile i "$si_backup/backup-$1-$2.json" '{published, applied_promotion_seq, entry_safe_block_seq: ($i[0].entry.safe_block_seq | tonumber), entry_applied_promotion_seq: ($i[0].entry.applied_promotion_seq | tonumber)} | . + {entry_published: (.entry_safe_block_seq <= .published and .entry_applied_promotion_seq <= .applied_promotion_seq)}'
  } 2>&1 | tee "$si_backup/backup-check-$1-$2.txt"
}
si_drill() { # $1 a|b|c, mutating (only in a confirmed block): the restore drill of that owner's newest backup this runbook made and checked (the last backup-<x>-<n>.json, with its passing backup-check-<x>-<n>.txt; restore-drill --backup <its name>, never "the latest", which a scheduled run may have replaced) on the P1 staging installation: ConfigMap si-p1-drill-config-<x> and Job si-p1-drill-<x> (si_p1_image, as si_restore with the restore-drill key, scratch hg_rstage.p1drill_<x>_<n>), waited for up to 70 minutes; saves the verdict line to drill-<x>.json and the log, once proven free of the drill key, to drill-<x>.log
  local owner cj job="si-p1-drill-$1" cm="si-p1-drill-config-$1" s="" i hits n=1 name chk
  owner="$(si_p1_owner "$1")" && cj="$(si_p1_cronjob "$1")" || return 2
  [ ! -e "$si_backup/drill-$1.json" ] || { echo "drill-$1.json exists: indexer-$1's drill ran; never re-run it" >&2; return 1; }
  [ -s "$si_backup/backup-$1-1.json" ] || { echo "no backup-$1-1.json: §8 first" >&2; return 1; }
  while [ -s "$si_backup/backup-$1-$((n + 1)).json" ]; do n=$((n + 1)); done
  name="$(jq -r .name "$si_backup/backup-$1-$n.json")" || return 1
  [[ "$name" =~ ^[0-9]{8}T[0-9]{6}Z-(full|incr)$ ]] || { echo "backup-$1-$n.json names no backup" >&2; return 1; }
  chk="$si_backup/backup-check-$1-$n.txt"
  if ! { grep -q "^backup-$1-$n.json: $name " "$chk" 2>/dev/null && grep -q "^the bucket's index object equals backup-$1-$n.json$" "$chk" && grep -q '^owner ClickHouse: BACKUP_CREATED $' "$chk" && grep -q '"entry_published":true' "$chk"; }; then
    echo "backup $name (backup-$1-$n.json) has no passing si_p1_backup_check $1 $n: run that check first" >&2
    return 1
  fi
  [ -z "$(si_kubectl get job "$job" --ignore-not-found -o name)$(si_kubectl get configmap "$cm" --ignore-not-found -o name)" ] || { echo "Job $job or ConfigMap $cm exists: §13 removes them before another drill" >&2; return 1; }
  si_kubectl get cronjob "$cj" -o json > "$si_backup/drill-$1-cronjob.json" || return 1
  si_kubectl get configmap "$cj" -o 'go-template={{index .data "config.yaml"}}' > "$si_backup/drill-$1-cronjob-config.yaml" || return 1
  si_p1_py drill-config "$si_backup/drill-$1-cronjob-config.yaml" "$owner" "$1" > "$si_backup/drill-config-$1.yaml" || return 1
  si_p1_py drill-job "$si_backup/drill-$1-cronjob.json" "$1" "$owner" "$(si_p1_rpc_url "$1")" "$(si_p1_image)" "$name" > "$si_backup/drill-job-$1.json" || return 1
  si_kubectl create configmap "$cm" --from-file=config.yaml="$si_backup/drill-config-$1.yaml" || return 1
  si_kubectl create -f "$si_backup/drill-job-$1.json" || return 1
  for i in $(seq 1 420); do
    s="$(si_kubectl get job "$job" -o jsonpath='{.status.succeeded}/{.status.failed}')" || s=""
    case "$s" in 1/*|*/[1-9]*) break ;; esac
    sleep 10
  done
  hits="$(si_kubectl logs "job/$job" | si_secret_hits restore-drill)" || hits=unknown
  if [ "$hits" = 0 ]; then si_kubectl logs "job/$job" > "$si_backup/drill-$1.log" 2>&1 || true; else echo "the log of Job $job holds the drill key ($hits lines) or could not be read: it is not saved; rotate the key (§15.3)" >&2; return 1; fi
  if ! si_p1_job_line si-restore-drill-v1 "$si_backup/drill-$1.log" > "$si_backup/drill-$1.json"; then
    rm -f "$si_backup/drill-$1.json"
    echo "Job $job (succeeded/failed: ${s:-unknown}) left no verdict line: read $si_backup/drill-$1.log" >&2
    return 1
  fi
  cat "$si_backup/drill-$1.json"
  case "$s" in 1/*) ;; *) echo "Job $job did not pass (succeeded/failed: ${s:-unknown}): read $si_backup/drill-$1.log and drill-$1.json" >&2; return 1 ;; esac
}
si_p1_active() { # $1 a|b|c: read-only: the owner's SI tables in the registry as its host answers them: every hg_safe table of its source ClickHouse, as <database>.<table> with the host's status, one TSV line each
  local t db tb
  for t in $(si_source_ch "$1" "SELECT name FROM system.tables WHERE database = 'hg_safe' ORDER BY name FORMAT TSV"); do
    case "$t" in *__*) db="${t%%__*}"; tb="${t#*__}" ;; *) echo "hg_safe.$t is not a <database>__<table> name" >&2; return 1 ;; esac
    printf '%s.%s\t%s\n' "$db" "$tb" "$(si_status "$1" "$db" "$tb" | jq -r .status)"
  done
}
si_p1_drill_check() { # $1 a|b|c: read-only: the verdict passes against the manifest of the latest backup's index, its verified tables are exactly the owner's Active tables, and the staging installation keeps no scratch of a verified partition; writes drill-check-<x>.txt
  local owner n=1
  owner="$(si_p1_owner "$1")" || return 2
  [ -s "$si_backup/drill-$1.json" ] || { echo "no drill-$1.json: run si_drill $1 first" >&2; return 1; }
  [ -s "$si_backup/backup-$1-1.json" ] || { echo "no backup-$1-1.json: §8 first" >&2; return 1; }
  while [ -s "$si_backup/backup-$1-$((n + 1)).json" ]; do n=$((n + 1)); done
  {
    si_p1_active "$1" > "$si_backup/active-$1.tsv"
    cat "$si_backup/active-$1.tsv"
    si_p1_py verdict-check "$si_backup/drill-$1.json" "$si_backup/backup-$1-$n.json" "$owner" "$si_backup/active-$1.tsv" "$(cat "$si_backup/expected-table-$1")"
    echo "scratch tables left on staging: $(si_p1s_ch "SELECT count() FROM system.tables WHERE database = 'hg_rstage' AND startsWith(name, 'p1drill_$1_')")"
  } 2>&1 | tee "$si_backup/drill-check-$1.txt"
}
si_p1_monitoring_commit() { # local only: the single-service commit that lists the three backup CronJobs in monitoring.backups.cronJobs with DEVNET2_MONITORED_BACKUPS; prints the commit
  local workflow_commit_before workflow_commit_after workflow_identity
  local file=k8s-sea/sentio-network-devnet2/storage-integrity-si-v2.yaml
  si_p1_fresh_main || return 1
  si_p1_py monitoring "$file" sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-a-si-backup sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-b-si-backup sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-c-si-backup || return 1
  si_p1_py mirror charts/storage-integrity/tests/test_render.py DEVNET2_MONITORED_BACKUPS - '("sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-a-si-backup", "sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-b-si-backup", "sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-c-si-backup")' || return 1
  si_p1_tests monitoring-backups || return 1
  git add -- "$file" charts/storage-integrity/tests/test_render.py || return 1
  git config --worktree commit.gpgsign true || return 1
  workflow_commit_before="$(git rev-parse HEAD)" || return 1
  git commit -q -m "chore(devnet2): backup alerts for the stage-3 P1 backup CronJobs" -m "Lists the backup CronJobs of indexer-a, indexer-b and indexer-c in monitoring.backups.cronJobs, which renders the storage-integrity-si-v2.backups rules StorageIntegrityBackupStale and StorageIntegrityBackupFailed, and DEVNET2_MONITORED_BACKUPS (docs/storage-integrity-devnet2-stage3-p1-backups.md §11)." -m "$si_p1_trailer" || { echo "commit/signing failed; preserve staged work and ask the user to unlock this repository actual signing key; no unsigned fallback" >&2; return 1; }
  workflow_commit_after="$(git rev-parse HEAD)" || return 1
  [ "$workflow_commit_after" != "$workflow_commit_before" ] || { echo "commit produced no new HEAD; stop" >&2; return 1; }
  workflow_identity="$(git log -1 --format='%an <%ae> %G?')" || return 1
  [ "$workflow_identity" = 'poetry <chen@sentio.xyz> G' ] || { echo "new HEAD must be poetry <chen@sentio.xyz> G; stop" >&2; return 1; }
  git verify-commit HEAD || return 1
  git show --stat --oneline HEAD | cat
}
si_p1_monitoring_apply() { # mutating (only in a confirmed block): pushes si_p1_monitoring_commit's commit and syncs storage-integrity-si-v2; the render changes only the VMRule, and no pod restarts
  local file=k8s-sea/sentio-network-devnet2/storage-integrity-si-v2.yaml x
  [ ! -e "$si_backup/monitoring-backups-commit" ] || { echo "monitoring-backups-commit exists: this step ran; never re-run it" >&2; return 1; }
  si_head_is charts/storage-integrity/tests/test_render.py "$file" || return 1
  si_p1_tests monitoring-backups-apply || return 1
  si_render_diff storage-integrity-si-v2 > "$si_backup/render-monitoring-backups.txt" || return 1
  [ "$(cat "$si_backup/render-monitoring-backups.txt")" = "changed VMRule/storage-integrity-si-v2" ] || { cat "$si_backup/render-monitoring-backups.txt" >&2; echo "the commit renders more than the VMRule differently: stop" >&2; return 1; }
  git rev-parse HEAD > "$si_backup/monitoring-backups-commit" || return 1
  git push origin HEAD:main || return 1
  helmfile -f k8s-sea/sentio-network-devnet2/storage-integrity-si-v2.helmfile.yaml sync --selector name=storage-integrity-si-v2 || return 1
  si_chi_state storage-integrity-si-v2 > "$si_backup/chi-network-after-monitoring.txt" || return 1
  diff "$si_backup/chi-network-before.txt" "$si_backup/chi-network-after-monitoring.txt" >&2 || { echo "the network CHI changed: stop (§14)" >&2; return 1; }
  for x in a b c; do si_p1_pods_check "$x" monitoring || return 1; done
  si_stamp > "$si_backup/monitoring-backups-synced-at"
}
si_p1_revert_chi() { # $1 b|c, mutating (only in a confirmed block): reverts si-backup-user-indexer-<x>-commit on origin/main, tests, pushes, applies the CHI file and waits until si_backup has left system.users; after a push it only applies and waits again
  local inst f c n
  case "$1" in b|c) ;; *) echo "si_p1_revert_chi: b or c; the network installation reverts with si_revert_stage3 (§14)" >&2; return 2 ;; esac
  inst="indexer-$1"; f="$si_backup/si-backup-user-$inst-commit"
  [ -f "$f" ] || { echo "no si-backup-user-$inst-commit: nothing to revert"; return 0; }
  if [ ! -f "$f.reverted" ]; then
    si_p1_fresh_main || return 1
    c="$(cat "$f")"
    git revert --no-edit "$c" || { git revert --abort; echo "reverting $c conflicts with a later commit on main: aborted, nothing changed (§14 names the order)" >&2; return 1; }
    si_p1_tests "revert-si-backup-user-$inst" || return 1
    git push origin HEAD:main || return 1
    git rev-parse HEAD > "$f.reverted"
  fi
  si_kubectl apply -f "k8s-sea/sentio-network-devnet2/storage-integrity-si-v2-$inst-source.yaml" || return 1
  for n in $(seq 1 30); do
    [ "$(si_ch_admin "$1" "SELECT count() FROM system.users WHERE name = 'si_backup'")" = 0 ] && { echo "host $1: si_backup is gone"; return 0; }
    sleep 10
  done
  echo "host $1: si_backup is still in system.users after 5 minutes" >&2
  return 1
}
si_p1_mech_url() { # the URL prefix of this §5 run's mechanics objects, mechanics/<stamp>
  local stamp
  stamp="$(cat "$si_backup/mech-stamp" 2>/dev/null)" || stamp=""
  [ -n "$stamp" ] || { echo "no mech-stamp: §5's first block starts the run" >&2; return 1; }
  printf '%s/mechanics/%s\n' "$si_p1_bucket_url" "$stamp"
}
si_p1_sql() { # $1 key account, then one or more SQL statements as arguments: runs them with si_s3_sql (a file under $si_backup/sql); stdout and stderr go to stdout, the return status is clickhouse-client's
  local f acct="$1"
  shift
  f="$(mktemp "$si_backup/sql/stmt.XXXXXX")" || return 1
  printf '%s;\n' "$@" > "$f"
  si_s3_sql "$acct" "$f" 2>&1
}
si_p1_status() { # $1 key account, $2 BACKUP or RESTORE statement: runs it and prints its final status (BACKUP_CREATED, RESTORED), lock-removal-denied, or si_s3_outcome's word; the output goes to mechanics-gcs.log
  local out rc=0
  out="$(si_p1_sql "$1" "$2 FORMAT TSV")" || rc=$?
  printf '== %s (%s, exit %s)\n%s\n' "${2%% TO *}" "$1" "$rc" "$out" >> "$si_backup/mechanics-gcs.log"
  if [ "$rc" = 0 ]; then printf '%s\n' "$out" | awk -F'\t' 'NF == 2 {s = $2} END {print (s == "" ? "error" : s)}'; return 0; fi
  if printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -qiE 'access denied.*removing object with path [^ ]*/\.lock'; then echo lock-removal-denied; return 0; fi
  printf '%s\n' "$out" | si_s3_outcome "$rc"
}
si_p1_mech_backups() { # mutating (only in a confirmed block), §5's backups: on the P1 staging installation, hg_safe.p1_mech (merges off as ddl.SafeSettings pins them, so its restored copy keeps its parts too); a full and an incremental BACKUP to mechanics/<stamp>-{full,incr}/ with the mechanics key; a RESTORE of partition 'a' from the incremental one with the restore-drill key, compared by hash_of_all_files and rows; a reused name and an overwrite, both refused
  local stamp u got full incr
  [ ! -e "$si_backup/mech-stamp" ] || { echo "mech-stamp exists: §5 ran with stamp $(cat "$si_backup/mech-stamp"); read mechanics-gcs.tsv" >&2; return 1; }
  stamp="p1mech-$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)"
  printf '%s\n' "$stamp" > "$si_backup/mech-stamp"
  printf 'check\texpect\tgot\n' > "$si_backup/mechanics-gcs.tsv"
  u="$(si_p1_mech_url)" || return 1
  si_p1s_ch "CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS hg_safe" || return 1
  si_p1s_ch "CREATE TABLE hg_safe.p1_mech (id UInt64, p String) ENGINE = MergeTree PARTITION BY p ORDER BY id SETTINGS max_bytes_to_merge_at_max_space_in_pool = 0" || return 1
  si_p1s_ch "SYSTEM STOP MERGES hg_safe.p1_mech" || return 1
  si_p1s_ch "INSERT INTO hg_safe.p1_mech VALUES (1, 'a'), (2, 'b')" || return 1
  si_p1s_ch "INSERT INTO hg_safe.p1_mech VALUES (3, 'a'), (4, 'b')" || return 1
  si_p1_check full_backup_created BACKUP_CREATED "$(si_p1_status backup-mech "BACKUP DATABASE hg_safe TO S3('$u-full/', '@@S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID@@', '@@S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY@@')")"
  si_p1s_ch "INSERT INTO hg_safe.p1_mech VALUES (5, 'a')" || return 1
  si_p1_check incremental_backup_created BACKUP_CREATED "$(si_p1_status backup-mech "BACKUP DATABASE hg_safe TO S3('$u-incr/', '@@S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID@@', '@@S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY@@') SETTINGS base_backup = S3('$u-full/', '@@S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID@@', '@@S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY@@')")"
  full="$(si_p1_sql restore-drill "SELECT count() FROM s3('$u-full/**', '@@S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID@@', '@@S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY@@', 'One')" | tail -n 1)"
  incr="$(si_p1_sql restore-drill "SELECT count() FROM s3('$u-incr/**', '@@S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID@@', '@@S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY@@', 'One')" | tail -n 1)"
  printf '== objects: full %s, incremental %s\n' "$full" "$incr" >> "$si_backup/mechanics-gcs.log"
  if [[ "$full" =~ ^[0-9]+$ && "$incr" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] && [ "$incr" -gt 0 ] && [ "$incr" -lt "$full" ]; then got=yes; else got="no (full ${full:-?}, incremental ${incr:-?})"; fi
  si_p1_check incremental_stores_fewer_objects yes "$got"
  si_p1s_ch "CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS hg_rstage" || return 1
  si_p1_check restore_from_incremental RESTORED "$(si_p1_status restore-drill "RESTORE TABLE hg_safe.p1_mech AS hg_rstage.p1mech_restore PARTITIONS 'a' FROM S3('$u-incr/', '@@S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID@@', '@@S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY@@')")"
  si_p1_check restore_keeps_hash_of_all_files equal "$(si_p1s_ch "SELECT if((SELECT groupArray((hash_of_all_files, rows)) FROM (SELECT hash_of_all_files, rows FROM system.parts WHERE database = 'hg_safe' AND table = 'p1_mech' AND active AND partition = 'a' ORDER BY hash_of_all_files, rows)) = (SELECT groupArray((hash_of_all_files, rows)) FROM (SELECT hash_of_all_files, rows FROM system.parts WHERE database = 'hg_rstage' AND table = 'p1mech_restore' AND active ORDER BY hash_of_all_files, rows)), 'equal', 'differs')")"
  si_p1_check restored_parts_of_a "$(si_p1s_ch "SELECT count() FROM system.parts WHERE database = 'hg_safe' AND table = 'p1_mech' AND active AND partition = 'a'")" "$(si_p1s_ch "SELECT count() FROM system.parts WHERE database = 'hg_rstage' AND table = 'p1mech_restore' AND active")"
  si_p1_check backup_name_reuse_refused exists "$(si_p1_status backup-mech "BACKUP DATABASE hg_safe TO S3('$u-full/', '@@S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID@@', '@@S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY@@')")"
  # Force a >5 MiB multipart upload before any owner backup; managed-folder multipart IAM is a live K25 gate.
  si_p1_probe multipart_upload_in_mechanics ok backup-mech "INSERT INTO FUNCTION s3('$u-multipart.bin', '@@S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID@@', '@@S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY@@', 'RawBLOB') SETTINGS s3_max_single_part_upload_size = 1048576, s3_min_upload_part_size = 5242880 SELECT repeat('mmmmmmmm', 786432)"
  si_p1_check multipart_readback_bytes 6291456 "$(si_p1_sql restore-drill "SELECT length(payload) FROM s3('$u-multipart.bin', '@@S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID@@', '@@S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY@@', 'RawBLOB', 'payload String')" | tail -n 1)"
  si_p1_probe overwrite_of_a_backup_object_refused denied backup-mech "INSERT INTO FUNCTION s3('$u-full/.backup', '@@S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID@@', '@@S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY@@', 'RawBLOB') SETTINGS s3_truncate_on_insert = 1 SELECT 'si-p1-overwrite-probe'"
}
si_p1_mech_lock() { # read-only, §5's versions: the object versions of this run's full backup in the bucket (gcloud, the user's own login): its .lock live and in all versions, its .backup in all versions; rows into mechanics-gcs.tsv
  local stamp g live all bk
  stamp="$(cat "$si_backup/mech-stamp" 2>/dev/null)" || stamp=""
  [ -n "$stamp" ] || { echo "no mech-stamp: run §5's first block first" >&2; return 1; }
  ! grep -q '^lock_live_after_full' "$si_backup/mechanics-gcs.tsv" || { echo "§5's versions block ran for this stamp: read mechanics-gcs.tsv" >&2; return 1; }
  g="gs://$si_p1_bucket/mechanics/$stamp-full"
  live="$( (gcloud storage ls "$g/.lock" 2>/dev/null || true) | grep -c '/\.lock$' || true)"
  all="$( (gcloud storage ls -a "$g/.lock" 2>/dev/null || true) | grep -c '/\.lock#[0-9]*$' || true)"
  bk="$( (gcloud storage ls -a "$g/.backup" 2>/dev/null || true) | grep -c '/\.backup#[0-9]*$' || true)"
  printf '== gcloud: %s/.lock live %s, versions %s; .backup versions %s\n' "$g" "$live" "$all" "$bk" >> "$si_backup/mechanics-gcs.log"
  if [ "$(si_p1_pin P1_BACKUP_DELETE)" = lock ]; then si_p1_check lock_live_after_full 0 "$live"; else si_p1_check lock_live_after_full 1 "$live"; fi
  si_p1_check lock_versions_after_full 1 "$all"
  si_p1_check backup_object_versions_after_overwrite 1 "$bk"
}
si_p1_mech_keys() { # mutating (only in a confirmed block), §5's keys: what each of the eight keys may list, read and write; every write it tries is either refused or lands under mechanics/
  local u c o other acct r
  u="$(si_p1_mech_url)" || return 1
  ! grep -q '^mech_lists_mechanics' "$si_backup/mechanics-gcs.tsv" || { echo "§5's keys block ran for this stamp: read mechanics-gcs.tsv" >&2; return 1; }
  c="$(si_p1_pin INDEXER_C_ID)" || return 1
  si_p1_probe mech_lists_mechanics ok backup-mech "SELECT count() FROM s3('$u-full/*', '@@S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID@@', '@@S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY@@', 'RawBLOB', 'raw_blob String')"
  si_p1_probe mech_lists_owner_0 denied backup-mech "SELECT count() FROM s3('$si_p1_bucket_url/owner-0/*', '@@S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID@@', '@@S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY@@', 'RawBLOB', 'raw_blob String')"
  si_p1_probe mech_reads_owner_0 denied backup-mech "SELECT count() FROM s3('$si_p1_bucket_url/owner-0/p1-mechanics-probe.index.json', '@@S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID@@', '@@S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY@@', 'RawBLOB', 'raw_blob String')"
  for o in 0 1 "$c"; do
    case "$o" in 0) other=1 ;; *) other=0 ;; esac
    acct="backup-$o"
    si_p1_probe "${acct}_lists_own_prefix" ok "$acct" "SELECT count() FROM s3('$si_p1_bucket_url/owner-$o/*', '@@S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID@@', '@@S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY@@', 'RawBLOB', 'raw_blob String')"
    si_p1_probe "${acct}_reads_own_prefix" missing "$acct" "SELECT count() FROM s3('$si_p1_bucket_url/owner-$o/p1-mechanics-probe.index.json', '@@S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID@@', '@@S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY@@', 'RawBLOB', 'raw_blob String')"
    si_p1_probe "${acct}_lists_owner_$other" denied "$acct" "SELECT count() FROM s3('$si_p1_bucket_url/owner-$other/*', '@@S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID@@', '@@S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY@@', 'RawBLOB', 'raw_blob String')"
    si_p1_probe "${acct}_reads_owner_$other" denied "$acct" "SELECT count() FROM s3('$si_p1_bucket_url/owner-$other/p1-mechanics-probe.index.json', '@@S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID@@', '@@S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY@@', 'RawBLOB', 'raw_blob String')"
    si_p1_probe "${acct}_writes_mechanics" denied "$acct" "INSERT INTO FUNCTION s3('$u-$acct-write.txt', '@@S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID@@', '@@S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY@@', 'RawBLOB') SELECT 'si-p1-write-probe'"
  done
  for r in a b c drill; do
    acct="restore-$r"
    si_p1_probe "${acct}_lists_mechanics" ok "$acct" "SELECT count() FROM s3('$u-full/*', '@@S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID@@', '@@S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY@@', 'RawBLOB', 'raw_blob String')"
    si_p1_probe "${acct}_lists_owner_0" ok "$acct" "SELECT count() FROM s3('$si_p1_bucket_url/owner-0/*', '@@S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID@@', '@@S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY@@', 'RawBLOB', 'raw_blob String')"
    si_p1_probe "${acct}_writes_mechanics" denied "$acct" "INSERT INTO FUNCTION s3('$u-$acct-write.txt', '@@S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID@@', '@@S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY@@', 'RawBLOB') SELECT 'si-p1-write-probe'"
  done
}
si_p1_hits_all() { # reads text on stdin and prints how many of its lines hold any of the eight secrets of §3; each secret comes from its Secret through file descriptors 3 to 10 (si_p1_key_fd), never argv, and none is written to disk or printed
  local c
  c="$(si_p1_pin INDEXER_C_ID)" || return 1
  python3 -I -c 'import sys
secrets = []
for fd in range(3, 11):
    with open(fd) as f:
        s = f.read().strip()
    if len(s) < 16:
        sys.exit("si_p1_hits_all: a secret of section 3 is missing or too short")
    secrets.append(s)
print(sum(1 for line in sys.stdin if any(s in line for s in secrets)))' \
    3< <(si_p1_key_fd backup-0) 4< <(si_p1_key_fd backup-1) 5< <(si_p1_key_fd "backup-$c") 6< <(si_p1_key_fd backup-mech) \
    7< <(si_p1_key_fd restore-a) 8< <(si_p1_key_fd restore-b) 9< <(si_p1_key_fd restore-c) 10< <(si_p1_key_fd restore-drill)
}
si_p1_key_fd() { # $1 key account: that account's secret, written only into the process substitution of si_p1_hits_all; never call it on its own
  si_kubectl get secret "storage-integrity-si-v2-$1" -o 'go-template={{index .data "secret"}}' | base64 -d
}
si_p1_mech_masking() { # mutating (only in a confirmed block), §5's masking: a BACKUP slowed by max_backup_bandwidth while system.processes is sampled; then no row of system.processes, system.query_log or system.backups and no line of the server log holds any of the eight secrets, and every logged statement of this run shows [HIDDEN]
  local u stamp samples n i bg rc=0
  u="$(si_p1_mech_url)" && stamp="$(cat "$si_backup/mech-stamp")" || return 1
  ! grep -q '^processes_sampled_backup' "$si_backup/mechanics-gcs.tsv" || { echo "§5's masking block ran for this stamp: read mechanics-gcs.tsv" >&2; return 1; }
  si_p1s_ch "CREATE TABLE hg_safe.p1_mech_bulk (id UInt64, s String) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY id" || return 1
  si_p1s_ch "INSERT INTO hg_safe.p1_mech_bulk SELECT number, randomPrintableASCII(64) FROM numbers(200000)" || return 1
  samples=""
  si_p1_status backup-mech "BACKUP DATABASE hg_safe TO S3('$u-slow/', '@@S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID@@', '@@S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY@@') SETTINGS max_backup_bandwidth = 1048576" > "$si_backup/mech-slow-status" &
  bg=$!
  for i in 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8; do
    sleep 2
    samples+="$(si_p1s_ch "SELECT query FROM system.processes WHERE startsWith(query, 'BACKUP') FORMAT TSVRaw" || true)"$'\n'
  done
  wait "$bg" || rc=$?
  n="$(printf '%s\n' "$samples" | grep -c "$stamp-slow" || true)"
  si_p1_check slow_backup_created BACKUP_CREATED "$(cat "$si_backup/mech-slow-status")"
  si_p1_check processes_sampled_backup yes "$([ "$n" -gt 0 ] && echo yes || echo no)"
  si_p1_check processes_show_hidden yes "$([ "$n" -gt 0 ] && [ "$(printf '%s\n' "$samples" | grep "$stamp-slow" | grep -vc "'\[HIDDEN\]'" || true)" = 0 ] && echo yes || echo no)"
  si_p1_check processes_secret_hits 0 "$(printf '%s\n' "$samples" | si_p1_hits_all)"
  samples=""
  si_p1s_ch "SYSTEM FLUSH LOGS" || return 1
  si_p1_check query_log_secret_hits 0 "$(si_p1s_ch "SELECT query, exception FROM system.query_log WHERE event_date >= yesterday() FORMAT TSVRaw" | si_p1_hits_all)"
  si_p1_check query_log_hidden yes "$([ "$(si_p1s_ch "SELECT countIf(position(query, '[HIDDEN]') = 0) FROM system.query_log WHERE event_date >= yesterday() AND position(query, '$stamp') > 0 AND (position(query, 'S3(') > 0 OR position(query, 's3(') > 0)")" = 0 ] && echo yes || echo no)"
  si_p1_check system_backups_secret_hits 0 "$(si_p1s_ch "SELECT name, base_backup_name, error FROM system.backups FORMAT TSVRaw" | si_p1_hits_all)"
  si_p1_check server_log_secret_hits 0 "$( { si_kubectl exec "$si_p1s_pod" -c clickhouse -- sh -c 'cat /var/log/clickhouse-server/clickhouse-server.log /var/log/clickhouse-server/clickhouse-server.err.log 2>/dev/null || true'; si_kubectl logs "$si_p1s_pod" -c clickhouse; } | si_p1_hits_all)"
  return "$rc"
}
si_p1_budget_left() { # read-only: the promotion budget §1.3 computed, minus every promotion since it was read
  local budget seq_then seq_now
  budget="$(sed -n 's/.*budget to L\/4 ([0-9]* bytes): \([0-9][0-9]*\) promotions;.*/\1/p' "$si_backup/budget.txt")"
  seq_then="$(cat "$si_backup/budget-live-seq")"; seq_now="$(si_show | jq -r .promotion_seq)"
  [ -n "$budget" ] && [ -n "$seq_then" ] && [ -n "$seq_now" ] || { echo "no budget: run §1.3 first" >&2; return 1; }
  echo $((budget - (seq_now - seq_then)))
}
si_p1_py() { # the runbook's local checks and edits (no cluster access): pr-state, hashes, staging-check, bucket, service-accounts, hmac, chi-add-user, values-add-user, enable-backup, monitoring, mirror, grants-check, cronjob-check, job-line, index-check, same-json, drill-config, drill-job, verdict-check, mech-verdict
  python3 -I -B - "$@" <<'PY'
import json
import os
import re
import sys

BUCKET = "sentio-352722-si-devnet2-si-v2-replica"
BUCKET_URL = "https://storage.googleapis.com/" + BUCKET
PROJECT = "sentio-352722"
WRITER_ROLE = f"projects/{PROJECT}/roles/siDevnet2SiV2BackupWriter"
LOCK_ROLE = f"projects/{PROJECT}/roles/siDevnet2SiV2BackupLockRemover"
WRITER_PERMISSIONS = ["storage.multipartUploads.abort", "storage.multipartUploads.create", "storage.multipartUploads.list", "storage.multipartUploads.listParts", "storage.objects.create", "storage.objects.get", "storage.objects.list"]
STAGING_USERS = ["default", "si_snode", "si_gateway", "si_reader", "si_backup", "si_restore"]
LOOPBACK_XML = '<clickhouse><users><default><networks replace="replace"><ip>::1</ip><ip>127.0.0.1</ip></networks><access_management>0</access_management></default></users></clickhouse>\n'
# system.grants of each user on ClickHouse 26.3 (measured on 26.3.51.7): (access_type, access_object, database, table).
GRANT_ROWS = {
    "si_backup": [("BACKUP", "", "hg_safe", None), ("CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE", "", None, None), ("READ", "S3", None, None), ("SELECT", "", "system", "backups"), ("SELECT", "", "system", "parts"), ("SELECT", "", "system", "tables"), ("WRITE", "S3", None, None)],
    "si_restore": [("ALTER", "", "hg_rstage", None), ("CREATE DATABASE", "", "hg_rstage", None), ("CREATE TABLE", "", "hg_rstage", None), ("CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE", "", None, None), ("DROP TABLE", "", "hg_rstage", None), ("INSERT", "", "hg_rstage", None), ("OPTIMIZE", "", "hg_rstage", None), ("READ", "S3", None, None), ("SELECT", "", "hg_rstage", None), ("SELECT", "", "system", "backups"), ("SELECT", "", "system", "parts"), ("SELECT", "", "system", "tables"), ("TRUNCATE", "", "hg_rstage", None)],
}


def fail(message):
    sys.exit(f"si_p1_py: {message}")


def load_yaml(path):
    import yaml
    with open(path) as f:
        return yaml.safe_load(f)


def test_render():
    sys.path.insert(0, os.path.abspath("charts/storage-integrity/tests"))
    import test_render as t
    return t


def pins(path):
    lines = open(path).read().split("\n")
    names = ["HG_TAG_P1", "CORE_TAG_P1", "SN_COMMIT_P1", "SN_DIGEST_P1", "P1_BACKUP_DELETE", "INDEXER_C_ID"]
    if len([line for line in lines if line]) != len(names):
        fail(f"{path} must hold six lines")
    return dict(zip(names, lines))


def hashes(path, users):
    doc = load_yaml(path)
    if not isinstance(doc, dict) or not isinstance(doc.get("passwordSha256"), dict):
        fail(f"{path}: no passwordSha256 mapping")
    got = doc["passwordSha256"]
    if sorted(got) != sorted(users):
        fail(f"{path}: users {sorted(got)}, expected {sorted(users)}")
    for user, value in got.items():
        if not isinstance(value, str) or not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{64}", value):
            fail(f"{path}: the hash of {user} is not 64 lowercase hex characters")
    return got


def cmd_pr_state(pins_path):
    p = pins(pins_path)
    t = test_render()
    if t.DEVNET2_MONITORING_ENABLED is not True:
        fail("S3-B monitoring is not enabled: stop before P1")
    owners = {"sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-a": 0, "sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-b": 1, "sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-c": int(p["INDEXER_C_ID"])}
    image = f"ghcr.io/sentioxyz/sentio-node:sha-{p['SN_COMMIT_P1']}@{p['SN_DIGEST_P1']}"
    checks = {
        "DEVNET2_SI_BACKUP_IMAGE": (t.DEVNET2_SI_BACKUP_IMAGE, image),
        "DEVNET2_BACKUP_DELETE_RIGHT": (t.DEVNET2_BACKUP_DELETE_RIGHT, p["P1_BACKUP_DELETE"]),
        "DEVNET2_BACKUP_OWNERS": (dict(t.DEVNET2_BACKUP_OWNERS), owners),
        "SI_BACKUP_BUCKET": (t.SI_BACKUP_BUCKET, BUCKET),
        "P1_STAGING_USERS": (tuple(t.P1_STAGING_USERS), tuple(STAGING_USERS)),
    }
    for name, (got, want) in checks.items():
        if got != want:
            fail(f"test_render.py {name} is {got!r}, the pins say {want!r}")
    state = {"si_backup users": dict(t.DEVNET2_SI_BACKUP_USER), "backup jobs": dict(t.DEVNET2_SI_BACKUP), "monitored backups": tuple(t.DEVNET2_MONITORED_BACKUPS)}
    off = all(v is False for v in state["si_backup users"].values()) and all(v is False for v in state["backup jobs"].values()) and not state["monitored backups"]
    print(f"P1 PR state: {'every si_backup user, backup job and backup alert off' if off else 'NOT the P1 PR state'}; owners {owners}; image {image}; delete right {p['P1_BACKUP_DELETE']}")
    if not off:
        fail(f"test_render.py is not in the P1 PR state: {state}")


def cmd_hashes(path, *users):
    for user, value in sorted(hashes(path, users).items()):
        print(f"{os.path.basename(path)}\t{user}\t{value}")


def cmd_staging_check(chi_path, hashes_path):
    doc = load_yaml(chi_path)
    conf = doc["spec"]["configuration"]
    want = hashes(hashes_path, STAGING_USERS)
    users = conf["users"]
    names = sorted({k.split("/")[0] for k in users})
    if names != sorted(STAGING_USERS):
        fail(f"{chi_path}: users {names}, expected {sorted(STAGING_USERS)}")
    for user, value in want.items():
        if users.get(f"{user}/password_sha256_hex") != value:
            fail(f"{chi_path}: {user}'s hash is not the one in {hashes_path}")
    if users.get("default/networks/ip") != ["127.0.0.1", "::1"] or "default/password" in users or "default/access_management" in users:
        fail(f"{chi_path}: default is not locked to loopback (posture C)")
    if (conf.get("files") or {}).get("users.d/zz-si-default-loopback.xml") != LOOPBACK_XML:
        fail(f"{chi_path}: the users.d loopback file is not posture C's")
    t = test_render()
    for user, grants in (("si_backup", t.SI_BACKUP_GRANTS), ("si_restore", t.SI_RESTORE_GRANTS)):
        if users.get(f"{user}/grants/query") != list(grants):
            fail(f"{chi_path}: {user}'s grants are not {grants}")
    checks = [
        (doc["metadata"]["name"], "storage-integrity-si-v2-p1-staging"),
        (conf["zookeeper"]["root"], "/storage-integrity/devnet2/p1-staging"),
        ([c["name"] for c in conf["clusters"]], ["source"]),
    ]
    for got, expected in checks:
        if got != expected:
            fail(f"{chi_path}: {got!r} is not {expected!r}")
    sizes = sorted({v["spec"]["resources"]["requests"]["storage"] for v in doc["spec"]["templates"]["volumeClaimTemplates"]})
    image = doc["spec"]["templates"]["podTemplates"][0]["spec"]["containers"][0]["image"]
    print(f"P1 staging CHI: storage-integrity-si-v2-p1-staging, root /storage-integrity/devnet2/p1-staging, users {', '.join(STAGING_USERS)} with the hashes of {os.path.basename(hashes_path)}, default locked, volumes {sizes}, image {image}")


def binding_members(policy, role, title=None):
    out = []
    for b in policy.get("bindings", []):
        if b.get("role") != role:
            continue
        cond = b.get("condition")
        if title is None and cond is None:
            out.extend(b.get("members", []))
        elif title is not None and cond is not None and cond.get("title") == title:
            out.append((tuple(b.get("members", [])), cond.get("expression", "")))
    return out


def cmd_bucket(bucket_path, iam_path, folders_path, writer_path, lock_path, pins_path):
    p = pins(pins_path)
    c = p["INDEXER_C_ID"]
    b = json.load(open(bucket_path))
    iam = b.get("iamConfiguration", {})
    checks = [
        ("name", b.get("name"), BUCKET),
        ("versioning", (b.get("versioning") or {}).get("enabled"), True),
        ("uniform bucket-level access", (iam.get("uniformBucketLevelAccess") or {}).get("enabled"), True),
        ("public access prevention", iam.get("publicAccessPrevention"), "enforced"),
        ("lifecycle", [(r.get("action", {}).get("type"), r.get("condition", {})) for r in (b.get("lifecycle") or {}).get("rule", [])], [("AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload", {"age": 7})]),
    ]
    for what, got, want in checks:
        if got != want:
            fail(f"bucket {what}: {got!r}, expected {want!r}")
    writer = json.load(open(writer_path))
    if sorted(writer.get("includedPermissions", [])) != WRITER_PERMISSIONS:
        fail(f"siDevnet2SiV2BackupWriter holds {sorted(writer.get('includedPermissions', []))}, expected {WRITER_PERMISSIONS}")
    policy = json.load(open(iam_path))
    writers = {"0": "owner-0/", "1": "owner-1/", c: f"owner-{c}/", "mech": "mechanics/"}
    # K25: each writer's role sits on the managed folder of its prefix, without a condition; a writer
    # role on the bucket would grant a list of every prefix, and no bucket condition can narrow a list.
    folders = sorted((f.get("name") or "").rstrip("/") + "/" for f in json.load(open(folders_path)))
    if folders != sorted(writers.values()):
        fail(f"the bucket's managed folders are {folders}, expected {sorted(writers.values())}")
    for key, prefix in writers.items():
        sa = f"serviceAccount:si-devnet2-si-v2-backup-{key}@{PROJECT}.iam.gserviceaccount.com"
        folder = json.load(open(os.path.join(os.path.dirname(folders_path), f"managed-folder-iam-{prefix.rstrip('/')}.json")))
        got = [(b2.get("role"), sorted(b2.get("members", [])), b2.get("condition")) for b2 in folder.get("bindings", [])]
        if got != [(WRITER_ROLE, [sa], None)]:
            fail(f"managed folder {prefix} binds {got!r}, expected only {WRITER_ROLE} for {sa} without a condition")
        locks = [m for b2 in policy.get("bindings", []) if b2.get("role") == LOCK_ROLE for m in b2.get("members", []) if m == sa]
        if p["P1_BACKUP_DELETE"] == "lock":
            lock_expr = f'resource.name.startsWith("projects/_/buckets/{BUCKET}/objects/{prefix}") && resource.name.endsWith("/.lock")'
            exprs = [b2["condition"]["expression"] for b2 in policy.get("bindings", []) if b2.get("role") == LOCK_ROLE and sa in b2.get("members", []) and b2.get("condition")]
            if exprs != [lock_expr]:
                fail(f"the lock-remover binding of backup-{key} is {exprs!r}, expected [{lock_expr!r}]")
        elif locks:
            fail(f"backup-{key} holds the lock remover although P1_BACKUP_DELETE is none")
    if p["P1_BACKUP_DELETE"] == "lock":
        lock = json.load(open(lock_path))
        if lock.get("includedPermissions") != ["storage.objects.delete"]:
            fail(f"siDevnet2SiV2BackupLockRemover holds {lock.get('includedPermissions')}, expected ['storage.objects.delete']")
    readers = sorted(binding_members(policy, "roles/storage.objectViewer"))
    want_readers = sorted(f"serviceAccount:si-devnet2-si-v2-restore-{r}@{PROJECT}.iam.gserviceaccount.com" for r in ("a", "b", "c", "drill"))
    if [m for m in readers if "si-devnet2-si-v2-" in m] != want_readers:
        fail(f"the restore readers are {readers}, expected {want_readers}")
    for b2 in policy.get("bindings", []):
        for m in b2.get("members", []):
            if m in ("allUsers", "allAuthenticatedUsers"):
                fail(f"{b2.get('role')} is granted to {m}")
            if m.startswith("serviceAccount:si-devnet2-si-v2-backup-") and b2.get("role") != LOCK_ROLE:
                fail(f"{m} holds {b2.get('role')} on the bucket; a backup writer holds its role on its own managed folder only (K25)")
            if m.startswith("serviceAccount:si-devnet2-si-v2-restore-") and b2.get("role") != "roles/storage.objectViewer":
                fail(f"{m} also holds {b2.get('role')}")
    print(f"bucket {BUCKET}: versioned, uniform access, public access prevented, aborts incomplete uploads after 7 days; writer role without delete; writers {', '.join(f'{k}={v}' for k, v in writers.items())}, each on its own managed folder only; lock remover {'on each writer, only */.lock' if p['P1_BACKUP_DELETE'] == 'lock' else 'absent'}; readers {', '.join(r.split(':')[1].split('@')[0].replace('si-devnet2-si-v2-', '') for r in want_readers)}")


def cmd_service_accounts(path, c):
    want = sorted(f"si-devnet2-si-v2-{a}@{PROJECT}.iam.gserviceaccount.com" for a in ("backup-0", "backup-1", f"backup-{c}", "backup-mech", "restore-a", "restore-b", "restore-c", "restore-drill"))
    got = sorted(line.split("\t")[0] for line in open(path).read().split("\n") if line.strip())
    if got != want:
        fail(f"service accounts {got}, expected {want}")
    disabled = [line for line in open(path).read().split("\n") if line.strip() and line.split("\t")[1:] not in (["False"], ["false"], [""])]
    if disabled:
        fail(f"disabled service accounts: {disabled}")
    print(f"{len(got)} service accounts, all enabled")


def cmd_hmac(list_path, logins_dir, c, out_path):
    accounts = ["backup-0", "backup-1", f"backup-{c}", "backup-mech", "restore-a", "restore-b", "restore-c", "restore-drill"]
    keys = json.load(open(list_path))
    rows = []
    for a in accounts:
        email = f"si-devnet2-si-v2-{a}@{PROJECT}.iam.gserviceaccount.com"
        mine = [k for k in keys if (k.get("serviceAccountEmail") or k.get("service_account_email")) == email and (k.get("state") or "").upper() == "ACTIVE"]
        if len(mine) != 1:
            fail(f"{a}: {len(mine)} active HMAC keys, expected 1")
        access_id = mine[0].get("accessId") or mine[0].get("access_id")
        path = os.path.join(logins_dir, f"hmac-{a}.access-id")
        if not os.path.isfile(path) or (os.stat(path).st_mode & 0o077):
            fail(f"{path} is missing or readable by others")
        if open(path).read().strip() != access_id:
            fail(f"{path} does not hold the active key's access id")
        rows.append(f"{a}\t{access_id}\tACTIVE")
    with open(out_path, "w") as f:
        f.write("account\taccess_id\tstate\n" + "\n".join(rows) + "\n")
    print(f"{len(rows)} accounts, one active HMAC key each, matching their access-id files")


def users_block_bounds(lines, key, indent):
    start = next((i for i, line in enumerate(lines) if line == " " * indent + key + ":"), None)
    if start is None:
        fail(f"no '{key}:' at indent {indent}")
    end = start + 1
    while end < len(lines) and (not lines[end].strip() or len(lines[end]) - len(lines[end].lstrip()) > indent):
        end += 1
    while end > start + 1 and not lines[end - 1].strip():
        end -= 1
    return start, end


def insert_after(path, key, indent, new_lines, check):
    lines = open(path).read().split("\n")
    start, end = users_block_bounds(lines, key, indent)
    before = load_yaml(path)
    updated = "\n".join(lines[:end] + new_lines + lines[end:])
    import yaml
    after = yaml.safe_load(updated)
    check(before, after)
    open(path, "w").write(updated)


def cmd_chi_add_user(chi_path, hashes_path):
    value = hashes(hashes_path, ["si_backup"])["si_backup"]
    t = test_render()
    doc = load_yaml(chi_path)
    if any(k.startswith("si_backup/") for k in doc["spec"]["configuration"]["users"]):
        fail(f"{chi_path} has si_backup already")
    child = 6
    new = [" " * child + f"si_backup/password_sha256_hex: {value}", " " * child + "si_backup/networks/ip:", " " * child + "- ::/0", " " * child + "si_backup/profile: default", " " * child + "si_backup/grants/query:"] + [" " * child + f"- {g}" for g in t.SI_BACKUP_GRANTS]

    def check(before, after):
        b, a = before["spec"]["configuration"]["users"], after["spec"]["configuration"]["users"]
        added = {k: v for k, v in a.items() if k not in b}
        want = {"si_backup/password_sha256_hex": value, "si_backup/networks/ip": ["::/0"], "si_backup/profile": "default", "si_backup/grants/query": list(t.SI_BACKUP_GRANTS)}
        if added != want or any(a[k] != v for k, v in b.items()):
            fail(f"{chi_path}: the edit would not add exactly si_backup's four keys")
        before["spec"]["configuration"]["users"] = a
        if before != after:
            fail(f"{chi_path}: the edit would change more than the users")
    insert_after(chi_path, "users", 4, new, check)
    print(f"{chi_path}: si_backup added (hash of {os.path.basename(hashes_path)}, SI_BACKUP_GRANTS)")


def cmd_values_add_user(path, hashes_path):
    value = hashes(hashes_path, ["si_backup"])["si_backup"]
    doc = load_yaml(path)
    access = doc["clickhouse"]["access"]
    if "backupUser" in access or "si_backup" in access["passwordSha256"]:
        fail(f"{path} sets si_backup already")
    lines = open(path).read().split("\n")
    start = next(i for i, line in enumerate(lines) if line == "    passwordSha256:")
    end = start + 1
    while end < len(lines) and lines[end].startswith("      "):
        end += 1
    lines = lines[:end] + [f'      si_backup: "{value}"'] + lines[end:]
    users_at = next(i for i, line in enumerate(lines) if line == "    users: true")
    lines = lines[:users_at + 1] + ["    # Stage-3 P1 (docs/storage-integrity-devnet2-stage3-p1-backups.md §6.3): the installation-wide backup user.", "    backupUser: true"] + lines[users_at + 1:]
    import yaml
    after = yaml.safe_load("\n".join(lines))
    want = json.loads(json.dumps(doc))
    want["clickhouse"]["access"]["backupUser"] = True
    want["clickhouse"]["access"]["passwordSha256"]["si_backup"] = value
    if after != want:
        fail(f"{path}: the edit would change more than backupUser and passwordSha256.si_backup")
    open(path, "w").write("\n".join(lines))
    print(f"{path}: clickhouse.access.backupUser true, passwordSha256.si_backup from {os.path.basename(hashes_path)}")


def cmd_enable_backup(path):
    doc = load_yaml(path)
    if (doc.get("siBackup") or {}).get("enabled") is not False:
        fail(f"{path}: siBackup.enabled is not false")
    lines = open(path).read().split("\n")
    start = next((i for i, line in enumerate(lines) if line == "siBackup:"), None)
    if start is None:
        fail(f"{path}: no top-level siBackup block")
    block = []
    for i in range(start + 1, len(lines)):
        if lines[i].strip() and not lines[i].startswith(" "):
            break
        block.append(i)
    at = [i for i in block if lines[i] == "  enabled: false"]
    if len(at) != 1:
        fail(f"{path}: siBackup has no single '  enabled: false' line")
    lines[at[0]] = "  enabled: true"
    import yaml
    after = yaml.safe_load("\n".join(lines))
    doc["siBackup"]["enabled"] = True
    if after != doc:
        fail(f"{path}: the edit would change more than siBackup.enabled")
    open(path, "w").write("\n".join(lines))
    print(f"{path}: siBackup.enabled true")


def cmd_monitoring(path, *names):
    doc = load_yaml(path)
    mon = doc.get("monitoring")
    if not isinstance(mon, dict) or mon.get("enabled") is not True:
        fail(f"{path}: monitoring is not enabled")
    if mon.get("backups") != {"cronJobs": []}:
        fail(f"{path}: monitoring.backups is {mon.get('backups')!r}, not the P1 PR's empty cronJobs list")
    lines = open(path).read().split("\n")
    start = next(i for i, line in enumerate(lines) if line == "monitoring:")
    at = [i for i in range(start + 1, len(lines) - 1) if lines[i] == "  backups:" and lines[i + 1] == "    cronJobs: []"]
    if len(at) != 1:
        fail(f"{path}: no single '  backups:' line followed by '    cronJobs: []' under monitoring")
    lines = lines[:at[0] + 1] + ["    cronJobs:"] + [f"      - {n}" for n in names] + lines[at[0] + 2:]
    import yaml
    after = yaml.safe_load("\n".join(lines))
    doc["monitoring"]["backups"] = {"cronJobs": list(names)}
    if after != doc:
        fail(f"{path}: the edit would change more than monitoring.backups.cronJobs")
    open(path, "w").write("\n".join(lines))
    print(f"{path}: monitoring.backups.cronJobs {list(names)}")


def cmd_mirror(path, constant, key, value):
    text = open(path).read()
    if key == "-":
        old = f"{constant} = ()\n"
        if text.count(old) != 1:
            fail(f"{path}: no single line '{old.strip()}'")
        text = text.replace(old, f"{constant} = {value}\n")
    else:
        m = re.search(r"^%s = \{\n((?:    .*\n)+?)\}\n" % re.escape(constant), text, re.M)
        if not m:
            fail(f"{path}: no {constant} dict")
        body = m.group(1)
        old = f'    "{key}": False,\n'
        if body.count(old) != 1:
            fail(f"{path}: {constant}[{key!r}] is not False")
        text = text[:m.start(1)] + body.replace(old, f'    "{key}": {value},\n') + text[m.end(1):]
    open(path, "w").write(text)
    print(f"{path}: {constant}{'' if key == '-' else f'[{key!r}]'} = {value}")


def cmd_grants_check(user, path):
    rows = [json.loads(line) for line in open(path) if line.strip()]
    got = sorted((r["access_type"], r["access_object"] or "", r["database"], r["table"]) for r in rows)
    want = sorted(GRANT_ROWS[user], key=lambda r: tuple("" if v is None else v for v in r))
    got = sorted(got, key=lambda r: tuple("" if v is None else v for v in r))
    extra = [r for r in rows if r.get("column") is not None or r.get("is_partial_revoke") not in (0, False) or r.get("grant_option") not in (0, False)]
    if got != want or extra:
        fail(f"{user}'s system.grants rows {got} (column, revoke or grant option on {extra}) are not {want}")
    print(f"{user}: system.grants is exactly its {len(want)} rows")


def cmd_cronjob_check(cron_path, config_path, owner, installation, image):
    cj = json.load(open(cron_path))
    spec = cj["spec"]
    pod = spec["jobTemplate"]["spec"]["template"]["spec"]
    [c] = pod["containers"]
    secret_envs = sorted((e["name"], e["valueFrom"]["secretKeyRef"]["name"], e["valueFrom"]["secretKeyRef"]["key"]) for e in c.get("env", []) if "valueFrom" in e and "secretKeyRef" in e["valueFrom"])
    want_envs = sorted([("STORAGE_INTEGRITY_CLICKHOUSE_PASSWORD", f"storage-integrity-si-v2-clickhouse-backup-{installation}", "password"), ("STORAGE_INTEGRITY_S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID", f"storage-integrity-si-v2-backup-{owner}", "access-id"), ("STORAGE_INTEGRITY_S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY", f"storage-integrity-si-v2-backup-{owner}", "secret")])
    cfg = load_yaml(config_path)["storage_integrity"]
    checks = [
        ("image", c["image"], image),
        ("command", c["command"], ["/sentio-node", "storage-integrity", "backup", "--config-path", "/etc/si-backup/config.yaml"]),
        ("secret env", secret_envs, want_envs),
        ("concurrencyPolicy", spec.get("concurrencyPolicy"), "Forbid"),
        ("suspend", spec.get("suspend", False), False),
        ("bucket_url", cfg["backup"]["bucket_url"], BUCKET_URL),
        ("owner_indexer_id", cfg["backup"]["owner_indexer_id"], int(owner)),
        ("clickhouse_username", cfg["clickhouse_username"], "si_backup"),
    ]
    for what, got, want in checks:
        if got != want:
            fail(f"CronJob {cj['metadata']['name']} {what}: {got!r}, expected {want!r}")
    text = open(config_path).read()
    for word in ("password", "secret", "access_key", "PRIVATE_KEY"):
        if word in text:
            fail(f"the CronJob's config names {word}")
    print(f"CronJob {cj['metadata']['name']}: schedule {spec['schedule']!r}, image {image}, owner {owner}, three Secret env vars, config without a secret")


def cmd_job_line(fmt, path):
    found = []
    for line in open(path):
        line = line.strip()
        if not line.startswith("{"):
            continue
        try:
            doc = json.loads(line)
        except ValueError:
            continue
        if isinstance(doc, dict) and doc.get("format") == fmt:
            found.append(doc)
    if len(found) != 1:
        fail(f"{path}: {len(found)} JSON lines of format {fmt}, expected exactly one")
    print(json.dumps(found[0], separators=(",", ":"), sort_keys=True))


def cmd_index_check(path, owner, table, prev=None):
    i = json.load(open(path))
    p = json.load(open(prev)) if prev else None
    want_kind, want_base, want_len = ("full", None, 1) if p is None else ("incr", p["name"], p["chain_length"] + 1)
    checks = [
        ("format", i.get("format"), "si-backup-index-v1"),
        ("network_id", i.get("network_id"), "devnet2"),
        ("owner_indexer_id", i.get("owner_indexer_id"), int(owner)),
        ("kind", i.get("kind"), want_kind),
        ("base", i.get("base"), want_base),
        ("chain_length", i.get("chain_length"), want_len),
        ("name", bool(re.fullmatch(r"[0-9]{8}T[0-9]{6}Z-" + want_kind, i.get("name", ""))), True),
        ("snapshot_id", bool(re.fullmatch(r"0x[0-9a-f]{64}", i.get("snapshot_id", ""))), True),
        ("entry.indexer_id", str(i.get("entry", {}).get("indexer_id")), str(owner)),
        ("owner's table", table.replace(".", "__", 1) in [t.get("physical_table") for t in i.get("tables", [])], True),
    ]
    if p is not None:
        checks.append(("name after the base", i["name"] > p["name"], True))
    for what, got, want in checks:
        if got != want:
            fail(f"{os.path.basename(path)} {what}: {got!r}, expected {want!r}")
    parts = sum(len(t.get("parts", [])) for t in i["tables"])
    print(f"{os.path.basename(path)}: {i['name']} {i['kind']} chain {i['chain_length']}{' on ' + i['base'] if i.get('base') else ''}, manifest {i['snapshot_id']}, {len(i['tables'])} tables, {parts} parts")


def cmd_same_json(a, b):
    if json.load(open(a)) != json.load(open(b)):
        fail(f"{a} and {b} differ")
    print(f"the bucket's index object equals {os.path.basename(a)}")


def cmd_drill_config(path, owner, x):
    doc = load_yaml(path)
    si = doc["storage_integrity"]
    si["clickhouse_dsn"] = "storage-integrity-si-v2-p1-staging-source:9000"
    si["clickhouse_username"] = "si_restore"
    si["backup"] = {"bucket_url": si["backup"]["bucket_url"], "owner_indexer_id": int(owner), "scratch_prefix": f"p1drill_{x}_"}
    if si["backup"]["bucket_url"] != BUCKET_URL:
        fail(f"the backup CronJob names bucket {si['backup']['bucket_url']}")
    import yaml
    sys.stdout.write(yaml.safe_dump(doc, sort_keys=False))


def cmd_drill_job(cron_path, x, owner, rpc, image, backup):
    if not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9]{8}T[0-9]{6}Z-(full|incr)", backup):
        fail(f"{backup!r} is not a backup name")
    cj = json.load(open(cron_path))
    pod = json.loads(json.dumps(cj["spec"]["jobTemplate"]["spec"]["template"]["spec"]))
    [c] = pod["containers"]
    if c["image"] != image:
        fail(f"the backup CronJob runs {c['image']}, not {image}")
    pod["containers"] = [{
        "name": "si-drill",
        "image": image,
        "command": ["/sentio-node", "storage-integrity", "restore-drill", "--config-path", "/etc/si-drill/config.yaml", "--owner", str(owner), "--owner-rpc", rpc, "--backup", backup],
        "env": [
            {"name": "STORAGE_INTEGRITY_CLICKHOUSE_PASSWORD", "valueFrom": {"secretKeyRef": {"name": "storage-integrity-si-v2-p1-staging-logins", "key": "si_restore"}}},
            {"name": "STORAGE_INTEGRITY_S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID", "valueFrom": {"secretKeyRef": {"name": "storage-integrity-si-v2-restore-drill", "key": "access-id"}}},
            {"name": "STORAGE_INTEGRITY_S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY", "valueFrom": {"secretKeyRef": {"name": "storage-integrity-si-v2-restore-drill", "key": "secret"}}},
        ],
        "volumeMounts": [{"name": "config", "mountPath": "/etc/si-drill", "readOnly": True}],
        "resources": c.get("resources", {}),
    }]
    pod["volumes"] = [{"name": "config", "configMap": {"name": f"si-p1-drill-config-{x}"}}]
    pod["restartPolicy"] = "Never"
    labels = {"app.kubernetes.io/component": "si-p1-drill", "app.kubernetes.io/instance": f"si-p1-drill-{x}"}
    job = {
        "apiVersion": "batch/v1",
        "kind": "Job",
        "metadata": {"name": f"si-p1-drill-{x}", "labels": labels},
        "spec": {"backoffLimit": 0, "activeDeadlineSeconds": 3600, "template": {"metadata": {"labels": labels}, "spec": pod}},
    }
    print(json.dumps(job, indent=1))


def cmd_verdict_check(drill_path, index_path, owner, active_path, table):
    v = json.load(open(drill_path))
    i = json.load(open(index_path))
    active = sorted(line.split("\t")[0] for line in open(active_path).read().split("\n") if line.strip() and line.split("\t")[1] == "active")
    verified = sorted(t["table_id"] for t in v.get("tables", []) if t.get("reason") == "verified")
    checks = [
        ("format", v.get("format"), "si-restore-drill-v1"),
        ("owner_indexer_id", v.get("owner_indexer_id"), int(owner)),
        ("backup", v.get("backup"), i["name"]),
        ("snapshot_id", v.get("snapshot_id"), i["snapshot_id"]),
        ("entry", v.get("entry"), i["entry"]),
        ("pass", v.get("pass"), True),
        ("every table verified or not in the manifest", sorted({t.get("reason") for t in v["tables"]} - {"verified", "not_in_manifest"}), []),
        ("verified tables = the owner's Active tables", verified, active),
        ("the owner's known table is verified", table in verified, True),
    ]
    for what, got, want in checks:
        if got != want:
            fail(f"{os.path.basename(drill_path)} {what}: {got!r}, expected {want!r}")
    for t in v["tables"]:
        if t["reason"] != "verified":
            continue
        for p in t["partitions"]:
            if p["reason"] != "verified" or p["kept"] != p["need"]:
                fail(f"{t['table_id']} partition {p['partition_id']}: {p}")
    lines = [f"{t['table_id']}: " + ", ".join(f"{p['partition_id']} need {p['need']} kept {p['kept']} dropped {p['dropped']}" for p in t["partitions"]) for t in v["tables"] if t["reason"] == "verified"]
    others = [t["physical_table"] for t in v["tables"] if t["reason"] == "not_in_manifest"]
    print(f"drill of owner {owner}: pass against {i['name']} (manifest {i['snapshot_id']}); verified = Active = {verified}; not in the manifest: {others or 'none'}")
    for line in lines:
        print("  " + line)


def cmd_mech_verdict(tsv_path, pins_path, iam_path):
    p = pins(pins_path)
    rows = [line.split("\t") for line in open(tsv_path).read().split("\n") if line.strip()]
    if rows and rows[0] == ["check", "expect", "got"]:
        rows = rows[1:]
    failed = [r for r in rows if len(r) != 3 or r[1] != r[2]]
    got = {r[0]: r[2] for r in rows if len(r) == 3}
    names = [r[0] for r in rows]
    for name, want in {"multipart_upload_in_mechanics": "ok", "multipart_readback_bytes": "6291456"}.items():
        if got.get(name) != want:
            fail(f"{tsv_path}: {name} must be {want}; stop and ask about K25")
    if len(names) != len(set(names)):
        fail(f"{tsv_path} repeats a check: run §5 from a fresh stamp")
    policy = json.load(open(iam_path))
    mech = f"serviceAccount:si-devnet2-si-v2-backup-mech@{PROJECT}.iam.gserviceaccount.com"
    lock_bound = any(b.get("role") == LOCK_ROLE and mech in b.get("members", []) for b in policy.get("bindings", []))
    full = got.get("full_backup_created")
    live, versions = got.get("lock_live_after_full"), got.get("lock_versions_after_full")
    if full == "BACKUP_CREATED" and versions == "1" and live == "0" and lock_bound:
        measured = "lock"
    elif full == "BACKUP_CREATED" and versions == "1" and live == "1" and not lock_bound:
        measured = "none"
    else:
        measured = "undetermined"
    print(f"{len(rows)} rows, {len(failed)} failed; measured delete right {measured}, P1_BACKUP_DELETE {p['P1_BACKUP_DELETE']}")
    for r in failed:
        print("  FAIL " + "\t".join(r))
    if failed or measured != p["P1_BACKUP_DELETE"]:
        sys.exit(1)


COMMANDS = {
    "pr-state": (cmd_pr_state, 1), "hashes": (cmd_hashes, None), "staging-check": (cmd_staging_check, 2), "bucket": (cmd_bucket, 6),
    "service-accounts": (cmd_service_accounts, 2), "hmac": (cmd_hmac, 4), "chi-add-user": (cmd_chi_add_user, 2), "values-add-user": (cmd_values_add_user, 2),
    "enable-backup": (cmd_enable_backup, 1), "monitoring": (cmd_monitoring, None), "mirror": (cmd_mirror, 4), "grants-check": (cmd_grants_check, 2),
    "cronjob-check": (cmd_cronjob_check, 5), "job-line": (cmd_job_line, 2), "index-check": (cmd_index_check, None), "same-json": (cmd_same_json, 2),
    "drill-config": (cmd_drill_config, 3), "drill-job": (cmd_drill_job, 6), "verdict-check": (cmd_verdict_check, 5), "mech-verdict": (cmd_mech_verdict, 3),
}
args = sys.argv[1:]
if not args or args[0] not in COMMANDS:
    fail("usage: si_p1_py " + " | ".join(sorted(COMMANDS)) + " <args>")
fn, arity = COMMANDS[args[0]]
if arity is not None and len(args) - 1 != arity:
    fail(f"{args[0]} takes {arity} arguments")
fn(*args[1:])
PY
}
```

`si_backup_run` and `si_drill` save a Job's log only after `si_secret_hits` found no line of it that holds the key the Job ran with, and take the Job's one result line (`objstore.BackupIndex` or `objstore.DrillVerdict`, which sentio-node prints alone on stdout) out of `kubectl logs`, which interleaves stdout with the logger's stderr, by its `format` field. `si_drill` derives the drill's config from the owner's backup CronJob config (its arbiter peers, network id and bucket) with only the ClickHouse address (the P1 staging installation), the user (`si_restore`) and the scratch prefix (`p1drill_<x>_`) changed, and its pod spec from that CronJob's (image pull secrets, node selector, resources) with the drill's command (`--backup` names the owner's newest backup of this runbook, the one `si_p1_backup_check` passed, so a scheduled run between §9 and §10 changes nothing), its config mount and exactly three Secret env vars: `STORAGE_INTEGRITY_CLICKHOUSE_PASSWORD` from `storage-integrity-si-v2-p1-staging-logins` key `si_restore`, and the `restore-drill` key. `si_p1_active` lists an owner's tables as its host answers them: each `hg_safe` table of its source ClickHouse, named `<database>__<table>` there, with the host's `sentio_getStorageIntegrityTableStatus` status, which the host derives from the table registry it follows.

## 1. Preparation

### 1.1 Pins

| Component | Pin | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| sentio-node of the backup CronJobs and the drill Jobs only | `ghcr.io/sentioxyz/sentio-node:sha-<SN_COMMIT_P1>@<SN_DIGEST_P1>` (housegate `<HG_TAG_P1>`, arbiter-core `<CORE_TAG_P1>`): `storage-integrity backup` and `storage-integrity restore-drill` | `DEVNET2_SI_BACKUP_IMAGE` in `test_render.py`; Plan S3-C1 Appendix C (Task 25) |
| Hosts, verifiers, voters | unchanged: Plan S3-B's `SN_DIGEST` and Plan S3-A's `ARBITER_DIGEST` | `images-before.txt` (§1.3) |
| ClickHouse, every SI installation and the P1 staging installation | `us-west1-docker.pkg.dev/sentio-352722/sentio/clickhouse-server:26.3-lts-decimal512-release-2026-09-16`, unchanged | the CHIs |
| The delete right a backup key holds | `<P1_BACKUP_DELETE>` (`none`: no delete at all; `lock`: each backup's own `/.lock` only, after the user amended spec §16 P1), measured by mechanics M13 on `26.3.37.3` and on the deployed image | Plan S3-C1 Appendix C (Task 24); `DEVNET2_BACKUP_DELETE_RIGHT` |
| indexer-c's indexer id | `<INDEXER_C_ID>`: its prefix `owner-<INDEXER_C_ID>/`, its backup account `backup-<INDEXER_C_ID>` | Plan S3-B Appendix C (Task 21) |

Create the evidence directory once, fresh, and record the pins (read-only for the cluster; the image check reads the registry):

```bash
[ ! -e "$si_backup" ] || { echo "$si_backup exists: this runbook starts a fresh evidence directory; move the old one aside"; exit 1; }
mkdir -m 700 "$si_backup"
mkdir -m 700 "$si_backup/sql"
HG_TAG_P1='<HG_TAG_P1>'; CORE_TAG_P1='<CORE_TAG_P1>'; SN_COMMIT_P1='<SN_COMMIT_P1>'; SN_DIGEST_P1='<SN_DIGEST_P1>'; P1_BACKUP_DELETE='<P1_BACKUP_DELETE>'; INDEXER_C_ID='<INDEXER_C_ID>'
case "$HG_TAG_P1$CORE_TAG_P1$SN_COMMIT_P1$SN_DIGEST_P1$P1_BACKUP_DELETE$INDEXER_C_ID" in *'<'*) echo "pins are still placeholders; stop"; exit 1 ;; esac
[[ "$HG_TAG_P1" =~ ^v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ && "$CORE_TAG_P1" =~ ^v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ && "$SN_COMMIT_P1" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ && "$SN_DIGEST_P1" =~ ^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$ && "$INDEXER_C_ID" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || { echo "a pin is malformed; stop"; exit 1; }
case "$P1_BACKUP_DELETE" in none|lock) ;; *) echo "P1_BACKUP_DELETE is none or lock; stop"; exit 1 ;; esac
[ "$(docker buildx imagetools inspect "ghcr.io/sentioxyz/sentio-node:sha-$SN_COMMIT_P1" | sed -n 's/^Digest: *//p')" = "$SN_DIGEST_P1" ] || { echo "sha-$SN_COMMIT_P1 does not resolve to $SN_DIGEST_P1; stop"; exit 1; }
printf '%s\n' "$HG_TAG_P1" "$CORE_TAG_P1" "$SN_COMMIT_P1" "$SN_DIGEST_P1" "$P1_BACKUP_DELETE" "$INDEXER_C_ID" > "$si_backup/pins"
si_p1_py pr-state "$si_backup/pins"
echo "pins resolve: $(si_p1_image)"
```

Expected: `P1 PR state: every si_backup user, backup job and backup alert off; owners {'sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-a': 0, 'sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-b': 1, 'sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-c': <INDEXER_C_ID>}; image …; delete right <P1_BACKUP_DELETE>` and `pins resolve: ghcr.io/sentioxyz/sentio-node:sha-<SN_COMMIT_P1>@<SN_DIGEST_P1>`. The pins file holds six lines in this order: `HG_TAG_P1`, `CORE_TAG_P1`, `SN_COMMIT_P1`, `SN_DIGEST_P1`, `P1_BACKUP_DELETE`, `INDEXER_C_ID`.

### 1.2 Identities, bucket and Secrets

The bucket is `sentio-352722-si-devnet2-si-v2-replica` (`https://storage.googleapis.com/sentio-352722-si-devnet2-si-v2-replica` in every `S3(...)`), versioned, with uniform bucket-level access and public access prevention. A backup is `BACKUP DATABASE hg_safe` named `<UTC yyyymmddThhmmssZ>-<full|incr>` under its owner's prefix, with its index object `<name>.index.json` beside it; `mechanics/` holds only §5's objects. - The enrolment of indexer-c has ended: `$HOME/si-devnet2-stage3-indexer-c/e-end.txt` exists, and every SI ClickHouse is locked (`$si_lockdown_dir/locked-network`, `locked-indexer-b`, `locked-indexer-c`).

- No backup CronJob, no P1 staging or lockdown staging installation, no `si_backup` or `si_restore` user on an SI ClickHouse, and an absent or empty Keeper root `/storage-integrity/devnet2/p1-staging`.

test -s "$HOME/si-devnet2-stage3-indexer-c/e-end.txt" || { echo "the indexer-c runbook has not recorded its end (its §9); stop"; exit 1; }
for i in network indexer-b indexer-c; do test -e "$si_lockdown_dir/locked-$i" || { echo "no lock record locked-$i: the lockdown is not done; stop"; exit 1; }; done

[[ "$git_read_4" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ && "$git_read_5" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]] || exit 1
[ "$git_read_4" = "$git_read_5" ] || { echo "the checkout is not at origin/main"; exit 1; }

  echo "keeper p1-staging: [$( (si_keeper "ls '/storage-integrity/devnet2/p1-staging'" 2>/dev/null || true) | tr -d '[:space:]')]"

Anything else: stop and clear it first.

The baseline every later block compares with (read-only):

  si_host_pods "$x" > "$si_backup/host-pods-$x-before.txt"
  si_kubectl get statefulset "sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-$x" -o jsonpath='{.metadata.generation} {.status.currentRevision} {.status.updateRevision}{"\n"}' > "$si_backup/sts-$x-before.txt"
````
