`member/gate` (new, Task 23; pure: no ClickHouse, no network; the install gate Plan S3-C2 reuses unchanged). Row hashes are 0x-prefixed lowercase LtHash hex; multisets are slices with repeats.
- `type Plan struct { Diverged bool; Need []string; Root string }`; `func PlanPartition(manifest []string, root string, local []string) (Plan, error)`: spec §8.5 steps 1–3 — `manifest` is M (the `PartRowLtHash` of every part S lists for (T, p)), `root` is R, `local` is L; `Diverged` when L is not a sub-multiset of M, else `Need` = M − L, sorted; refusal `gate: manifest parts sum to %s, not the partition root %s` when Σ(M) ≠ R.
- `type Outcome string` with `OutcomeKept = "kept"`, `OutcomeRenameRace = "rename_race"`, `OutcomeSplit = "split"`, `OutcomeDoubled = "doubled"`, `OutcomeForeign = "foreign"`; `type Expected struct { RowLtHash string; Rows uint64 }`; `type Fetch struct { Need []string; Single *Expected }` (`Single` set for a pull of one named source part, nil for a restore); `type ScratchPart struct { Name, RowLtHash string; Rows uint64 }`; `type Classification struct { Outcome Outcome; Keep, Drop, Kept []string }` (`Keep` and `Drop` are scratch part names, `Kept` the needed hashes the kept parts satisfy); `func Classify(f Fetch, scratch []ScratchPart) (Classification, error)`. Rules (spec §8.5 step 4): a restore keeps each part whose hash is still in `Need`, once per occurrence, and drops every other part (`kept`; extra parts of a backup ahead of publication are never Foreign); a pull with zero rows is `rename_race`; one part equal to `Single` (hash and rows) and in `Need` is `kept`; two or more parts whose sum and rows equal `Single` are `split`; parts summing to `Single` added to itself with twice its rows are `doubled`; anything else is `foreign`, with nothing dropped (the scratch is kept for forensics). The caller retries `rename_race` and `doubled` once from a clean scratch and moves to the next source on `split` (Plan S3-C2).
- `func Closure(root string, local, kept []string) error`: Σ(L) + Σ(kept) = R (spec §8.5 step 6), refusal `gate: closure: %d local and %d kept parts sum to %s, the partition root is %s`; `func PartitionSet(manifest, local []string) error`: the local partition ids equal the manifest's, refusal `gate: partition set %v is not the manifest's %v`.
- Tests: `TestPlanPartitionNeedIsManifestMinusLocal`, `TestPlanPartitionIsDivergedWhenLocalIsNotASubMultiset`, `TestPlanPartitionRefusesAManifestWhosePartsDoNotSumToItsRoot`, `TestClassifyRestoreKeepsOnlyNeededPartsAndDropsTheRest`, `TestClassifyKeepsANeededPullOnce`, `TestClassifyZeroRowsIsARenameRace`, `TestClassifyPartsSummingToTheNeedAreASplit`, `TestClassifyDoubledRowsAreDoubled`, `TestClassifyAnythingElseIsForeignAndDropsNothing`, `TestClosureIsArithmetic`, `TestPartitionSetMustEqualTheManifests`.

`dataplane/objstore` (new, Task 24): the only code that renders `S3(...)` / `s3(...)` (K23); no Go S3 or GCS client.
- Constants: `SafeDatabase = "hg_safe"`, `StageDatabase = "hg_rstage"`, `BackupIndexFormat = "si-backup-index-v1"`, `DrillVerdictFormat = "si-restore-drill-v1"`, `IndexSuffix = ".index.json"`, `DefaultMaxChainLinks = 7`, `MaxChainLinksLimit = 30`; `type BackupKind string` with `BackupFull BackupKind = "full"`, `BackupIncremental BackupKind = "incr"`.
- `type Credentials struct { AccessKeyID, SecretAccessKey string }` with `String()` and `LogValue()` printing `AccessKeyID` and `[redacted]` for the secret.
- `type Bucket struct` (unexported fields); `func ParseBucket(raw string) (Bucket, error)` accepts `http(s)://<host>[:port]/<bucket>` only (refusal `objstore: bucket %q must be http(s)://<host>[:port]/<bucket> with no further path, query or trailing slash`); `func (b Bucket) URL() string`; `func OwnerPrefix(owner uint64) string` = `owner-<owner>/`; `func (b Bucket) BackupURL(owner uint64, name string) string` = `<url>/owner-<owner>/<name>/`; `func (b Bucket) IndexURL(owner uint64, name string) string` = `<url>/owner-<owner>/<name>.index.json`; `func (b Bucket) IndexGlob(owner uint64) string` = `<url>/owner-<owner>/*.index.json`; `func BackupName(at time.Time, kind BackupKind) string` = `at.UTC().Format("20060102T150405Z") + "-" + string(kind)`.
- Index object (JSON, field names binding; written once, never rewritten): `type BackupIndex struct { Format string "format"; NetworkID string "network_id"; OwnerIndexerID uint64 "owner_indexer_id"; Name string "name"; Kind BackupKind "kind"; Base string "base,omitempty"; ChainLength uint32 "chain_length"; StartedAt string "started_at"; FinishedAt string "finished_at"; SnapshotID string "snapshot_id"; Entry replay.TrackFrontier "entry"; Tables []BackupIndexTable "tables" }` (times RFC 3339 UTC; `SnapshotID` the latest published manifest when the backup started, `Entry` its `track_frontiers[owner]`); `type BackupIndexTable struct { PhysicalTable string "physical_table"; TableID string "table_id,omitempty"; IncarnationSeq uint64 "incarnation_seq"; Parts []BackupIndexPart "parts" }` (`TableID` the id S lists under that physical name (`ddl.CHTableName`), empty when S lists none; `IncarnationSeq` from the table's `ddl.ParseIncarnationComment`, 0 for a genesis table); `type BackupIndexPart struct { Name string "name"; PartitionID string "partition_id"; PhysHash string "phys_hash"; Rows uint64 "rows" }` (from `chparts.ActiveParts` right before BACKUP; `PartitionID` in the logical form).
- SQL renderers (the URL and the two key strings are the only interpolated values, single-quoted with `chparts.EscapeSQLString`; everything else is a query parameter): `func BackupSQL(b Bucket, owner uint64, name, base string, c Credentials) string` = `BACKUP DATABASE hg_safe TO S3('<BackupURL(name)>', '<id>', '<secret>')`, plus ` SETTINGS base_backup = S3('<BackupURL(base)>', '<id>', '<secret>')` when `base` is set; `func PartitionClause(sch payloadexec.TableSchema, partitionID string) (string, error)` = `""` for `all`, else `PARTITIONS ` + `chparts.QuotePartition`; `func RestoreSQL(b Bucket, owner uint64, name, physicalTable, partitionClause string, s Scratch, c Credentials) string` = `RESTORE TABLE hg_safe.<physicalTable> AS <s.Qualified()> <partitionClause> FROM S3('<BackupURL(name)>', '<id>', '<secret>')`; the index is written with one `INSERT INTO FUNCTION s3('<IndexURL>', '<id>', '<secret>', 'RawBLOB')` whose JSON is a query parameter, with `s3_truncate_on_insert = 0` (an existing object is refused, never overwritten), and read with `SELECT _file, * FROM s3('<IndexGlob>', '<id>', '<secret>', 'RawBLOB')`.
- Scratch: `type Scratch struct { Database, Table string }`, `func (s Scratch) Qualified() string` (backquoted `` `<Database>`.`<Table>` ``: `hg_rstage` for every scratch of this plan and of Plan S3-C2, `hg_promote` for Plan S3-D's rebuild scratch); `type ScratchNamer struct` (unexported fields), `func NewScratchNamer(prefix string) (*ScratchNamer, error)` (refusal `objstore: scratch prefix %q must match [A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}`), `func (n *ScratchNamer) Next() Scratch` (`hg_rstage.<prefix><n>`, n = 1, 2, …). `hg_rstage` is created with `CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS hg_rstage` (no `ENGINE`, spec §8.2).
- Manifests (spec §8.4's accept rule): `type ManifestSource interface { Latest(ctx context.Context) (replay.SafeSnapshotManifest, error); Manifest(ctx context.Context, snapshotID string) (replay.SafeSnapshotManifest, error) }`; `func NewArbiterManifests(c *dataplane.Client) ManifestSource` (the existing `SafeState.GetSafeWatermark` and `GetManifest` RPCs through `c.WithLeaderRetry`, every answer through `CheckManifest`; not cached; not `dataplane.ManifestStore`); `func CheckManifest(requested string, m replay.SafeSnapshotManifest) error` — refusals verbatim `objstore: manifest %s answered for %s` (id ≠ requested), `objstore: manifest %s is not its own root %s` (id ≠ `ManifestRoot`), `objstore: manifest %s: %w` (`Validate`, then `payloadexec.VerifyLedger`). `objstore: manifest %s has no track frontier for indexer %d` when `replay.OwnerEntry` finds none.
- Backups: `type Backuper struct { Conn clickhouse.Conn; Manifests ManifestSource; Bucket Bucket; Owner uint64; NetworkID string; Credentials Credentials; MaxChainLinks uint32; Now func() time.Time }` (`MaxChainLinks` 0 → 7, else 1–30, refusal `objstore: max chain links %d must be between 1 and 30`; `Now` nil → `time.Now`); `func (b *Backuper) Run(ctx context.Context) (BackupIndex, error)`: latest manifest and owner entry; `ReadIndexes`; `NextBackup`; refuse a name whose index or backup exists (`objstore: backup %s of indexer %d exists already; a backup name is never reused`); list `hg_safe` tables (`system.tables` name and comment) and their parts; `BackupSQL`; write the index; return it. `func ReadIndexes(ctx context.Context, conn clickhouse.Conn, b Bucket, owner uint64, c Credentials) ([]BackupIndex, error)` (sorted by name; an object that does not decode as `BackupIndexFormat` stops: `objstore: index %s is not a %s object: %v`); `func NextBackup(latest *BackupIndex, maxChainLinks uint32) (BackupKind, string, uint32)` (full with chain length 1 when `latest` is nil or its chain length reached `maxChainLinks`, else incremental on `latest.Name` with chain length + 1).
- Restore and gate (spec §8.5 with only the object-store source, §8.6): `type BackupRef struct { Bucket Bucket; Owner uint64; Name string; Credentials Credentials }`; `type GateInput struct { Backup BackupRef; Manifest replay.SafeSnapshotManifest; TableID, PhysicalTable string; Schema payloadexec.TableSchema; PartitionID string; Local []string; Scratch Scratch }`; `type GateResult struct { Plan gate.Plan; Classification gate.Classification; KeptParts []string; Complete bool; Reason DrillReason }`; `func RestoreAndGate(ctx context.Context, conn clickhouse.Conn, in GateInput) (GateResult, error)`: `gate.PlanPartition` (Diverged → `Complete` false), `RestoreSQL` into the fresh scratch, `chexec.ScanAllParts` on `in.Scratch.Database + "." + in.Scratch.Table` (unquoted: `chexec` quotes it), `gate.Classify` in restore mode, `ALTER TABLE <scratch> DROP PART '<name>'` for every dropped part, `gate.Closure` and `gate.PartitionSet`; `KeptParts` stay in the scratch, ready for `ATTACH PARTITION … FROM` (Plan S3-C2); a drill passes `Local` empty.
- Drills: `type SchemaSource interface { TableSchema(ctx context.Context, tableID string) (payloadexec.TableSchema, error) }`; `type Drill struct { Conn clickhouse.Conn; Manifests ManifestSource; Schemas SchemaSource; Bucket Bucket; Owner uint64; NetworkID string; Credentials Credentials; Backup string; Scratch *ScratchNamer }` (`Backup` "" = the owner's latest backup; refusal `objstore: no backup of indexer %d under %s`); `func (d *Drill) Run(ctx context.Context) (DrillVerdict, error)`. `type DrillReason string` with `DrillVerified = "verified"`, `DrillNotInManifest = "not_in_manifest"`, `DrillSchemaHashMismatch = "schema_hash_mismatch"`, `DrillRestoreFailed = "restore_failed"`, `DrillNeedUnsatisfied = "need_unsatisfied"`, `DrillClosureMismatch = "closure_mismatch"`, `DrillPartitionSetMismatch = "partition_set_mismatch"`; `type DrillPartition struct { PartitionID string "partition_id"; Reason DrillReason "reason"; Need int "need"; Kept int "kept"; Dropped int "dropped"; Scratch string "scratch,omitempty" }`; `type DrillTable struct { TableID string "table_id"; PhysicalTable string "physical_table"; IncarnationSeq uint64 "incarnation_seq"; Reason DrillReason "reason"; Partitions []DrillPartition "partitions" }`; `type DrillVerdict struct { Format string "format"; OwnerIndexerID uint64 "owner_indexer_id"; Backup string "backup"; SnapshotID string "snapshot_id"; Entry replay.TrackFrontier "entry"; Tables []DrillTable "tables"; Pass bool "pass" }`. The drill takes S = `Manifests.Manifest(index.SnapshotID)` (never the latest manifest), checks `payloadexec.TableSchemaHash(NetworkID, schema)` against S's `schema_hash` for each table, gates every partition S lists, drops a verified partition's scratch and keeps (and names) a failing one; `Pass` = at least one table `verified` and every table except `not_in_manifest` ones `verified` (K27).
- Tests (no ClickHouse): `TestBucketURLsAndBackupNames`, `TestParseBucketRefusesAPathQueryOrTrailingSlash`, `TestCredentialsRedactTheSecret`, `TestBackupSQLNamesTheBaseOnlyForAnIncrementalBackup`, `TestRestoreSQLRestoresOnePartitionIntoTheScratch`, `TestPartitionClauseOfAnUnpartitionedTableIsEmpty`, `TestNextBackupStartsAFullBackupAfterMaxChainLinks`, `TestBackupIndexJSONFieldNames`, `TestCheckManifestRefusesAWrongIDRootOrLedger`, `TestDrillVerdictPassRule`. Tests gated on ClickHouse and the mechanics MinIO (`ARBITER_CH_S3=1`, run only inside `scripts/ci/clickhouse-mechanics.sh`, every one required to PASS): `TestS3_BackuperRunsAFullThenAnIncrementalBackup`, `TestS3_BackuperNeverReusesABackupName`, `TestS3_RestoreAndGateKeepsOnlyTheManifestsPartsFromABackupAheadOfPublication`, `TestS3_RestoreAndGateReportsANeedTheBackupCannotMeet`, `TestS3_DrillVerifiesABackupAgainstTheManifestItsIndexNames`, `TestS3_DrillFailsWhenNoTableOfTheOwnerIsVerified`, `TestS3_DrillRefusesASchemaWhoseHashIsNotTheManifests`.

Mechanics M12–M14 (Task 24; `dataplane/chmechanics/s3_test.go`, opt-in and gated exactly like Plan S3-A's suite, contract §3; the labels continue Plan S3-A's M0–M11, Plan S3-B's lockdown grant probe carries none, and Plan S3-D continues from M15, decision D32):

- `google_service_account.storage_integrity_devnet2_si_v2_backup` (`for_each = local.si_v2_backup_writers`, `account_id = "si-devnet2-si-v2-backup-${each.key}"`); `google_storage_managed_folder.storage_integrity_devnet2_si_v2_backup` (`for_each` the same, `bucket` = the replica bucket, `name = each.value`, `force_destroy = false`: the managed folders `owner-0/`, `owner-1/`, `owner-<INDEXER_C_ID>/` and `mechanics/`); `google_storage_managed_folder_iam_member.storage_integrity_devnet2_si_v2_backup_writer` (`for_each` the same, `bucket` and `managed_folder` = that folder's `bucket` and `name`, the writer role, the backup service account `[each.key]`, no condition). No writer holds any role on the bucket itself except the lock remover below (K25): GCS checks a list on the bucket, and an IAM Condition of a bucket binding cannot test a list's prefix (Cloud Storage's API attributes are supported only in Credential Access Boundaries), so the managed folder is what confines a writer's list to its prefix.
- Only when `local.si_v2_backup_delete_right == "lock"` (K24, after the spec amendment): `google_project_iam_custom_role.storage_integrity_devnet2_si_v2_backup_lock_remover` (`role_id = "siDevnet2SiV2BackupLockRemover"`, permissions `storage.objects.delete`) and `google_storage_bucket_iam_member.storage_integrity_devnet2_si_v2_backup_lock_remover` (`for_each` the writers, condition `resource.name.startsWith("projects/_/buckets/<bucket>/objects/<prefix>") && resource.name.endsWith("/.lock")`).
- `google_service_account.storage_integrity_devnet2_si_v2_restore` (`for_each = toset(local.si_v2_restore_readers)`, `account_id = "si-devnet2-si-v2-restore-${each.key}"`); `google_storage_bucket_iam_member.storage_integrity_devnet2_si_v2_restore_viewer` (`role = "roles/storage.objectViewer"`, no condition).
- No HMAC key, no key file and no Secret is a Terraform resource (Terraform Cloud state would hold them). The user applies with `terraform -chdir=terraform plan -out=/tmp/si-devnet2-si-v2-replica.tfplan` and one `-target=` per resource above, then `terraform -chdir=terraform apply /tmp/si-devnet2-si-v2-replica.tfplan` (the `docs/storage-integrity-devnet2-si-v2.md` §1.1 convention).

production, ClickHouse users (Task 26; the S3-B §11 form: `<user>/password_sha256_hex` literal, `networks/ip: ["::/0"]`, `profile: default`, `grants/query`; never `valueFrom`, never SQL `CREATE USER`):
- `si_backup` on `storage-integrity-si-v2` (charts/storage-integrity: `clickhouse.access.backupUser`, default false, and `clickhouse.access.passwordSha256.si_backup`, required exactly when rendered), `storage-integrity-si-v2-indexer-b` and `storage-integrity-si-v2-indexer-c` (manifests), and the P1 staging installation. Grants `SI_BACKUP_GRANTS` (verbatim, in this order): `GRANT BACKUP ON hg_safe.*`; `GRANT READ, WRITE ON S3`; `GRANT CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE ON *.*`; `GRANT SELECT ON system.parts`; `GRANT SELECT ON system.tables`; `GRANT SELECT ON system.backups`.
- `si_restore` only on the P1 staging installation. Grants `SI_RESTORE_GRANTS` (verbatim): `GRANT CREATE DATABASE ON hg_rstage.*`; `GRANT SELECT, INSERT, ALTER, CREATE TABLE, DROP TABLE, TRUNCATE, OPTIMIZE ON hg_rstage.*`; `GRANT READ ON S3`; `GRANT CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE ON *.*`; `GRANT SELECT ON system.parts`; `GRANT SELECT ON system.tables`; `GRANT SELECT ON system.backups`. The `hg_rstage` rights are spec §8.2's as amended (decision D36): never `ALL`, so no dictionary, `SYSTEM` or definer right there. ClickHouse still grants `CREATE VIEW` and `DROP VIEW` implicitly with `CREATE TABLE` and `DROP TABLE` on the same database (Plan S3-B's measured `role_atoms`), so a plain view in `hg_rstage` is not one of the refusals below; a view that names another definer needs `SET DEFINER`, which `si_restore` lacks.
- M13 (§17) and the staging grant probe fix both lists; a measured difference changes both copies (arbiter-core `chmechanics` and production `test_render.py`) in one step and is recorded in Appendix B.
- validate.yaml refusals (verbatim): `clickhouse.access.backupUser requires clickhouse.access.users`; `clickhouse.access.passwordSha256.si_backup is required when clickhouse.access.backupUser is set`.
- Grant probe (`charts/storage-integrity/tests/clickhouse_grant_probe.tsv`, S3-B §11) gains `si_backup` and `si_restore` rows: positive (no 497), at least one for every grant of the role (`test_grant_probe_covers_every_protocol_grant`), `BACKUP TABLE hg_safe.<t> TO S3('http://127.0.0.1:1/probe/', 'k', 's')` and `SELECT * FROM s3('http://127.0.0.1:1/probe.json', 'k', 's', 'RawBLOB')` for `si_backup`, `CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS hg_rstage`, `CREATE TABLE hg_rstage.si_grant_probe_restore (v Int64) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple()` (the S3-B corpus's form), an `INSERT`, a `SELECT`, an `ALTER TABLE … DROP PARTITION`, a `TRUNCATE`, an `OPTIMIZE` and a `DROP TABLE` on `hg_rstage.si_grant_probe_restore` and the `s3()` read for `si_restore` (S3 probes carry `backup_restore_s3_retry_attempts = 0` or `s3_retry_attempts = 0`; S3 inserts also carry `async_insert = 0`, exactly as Task 26 writes them), and each role's `CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE` and `system.parts`, `system.tables` and `system.backups` reads; negative (497) a `SELECT`, an `INSERT` and an `ALTER TABLE … DROP PARTITION` on `hg_safe` and a `CREATE TABLE` in `hg_rstage` for `si_backup`, a `BACKUP`, an `INSERT INTO FUNCTION s3(...)`, a `CREATE DICTIONARY` in `hg_rstage`, a `SYSTEM STOP MERGES hg_rstage.probe` and a `CREATE VIEW` in `hg_rstage` with `DEFINER = default SQL SECURITY DEFINER` for `si_restore` (D36; the rows that name `hg_rstage.si_grant_probe_restore` run before its `DROP TABLE`, since a missing table answers before the access check), and an `INSERT INTO FUNCTION remote(...)` for both.
- P1 staging installation: CHI `storage-integrity-si-v2-p1-staging`, file `docs/examples/storage-integrity-p1-staging-chi.yaml` (indexer-b's posture C CHI renamed, cluster `source`, pod `storage-integrity-si-v2-p1-staging-source-0-0-0`, Service `storage-integrity-si-v2-p1-staging-source` (8123, 9000), Keeper root `/storage-integrity/devnet2/p1-staging`, 2Gi volumes, born locked with the users of `make-clickhouse-logins.sh p1-staging` and their literal hashes), reconciled by the frozen `devnet2-operator`; created and deleted by Task 28 (runbook §4, §13).

### 19. devnet2, the ledger, repositories and commands (Tasks 22–28)

devnet2 (Task 28; runbook of §18, one stage per window, every mutating block confirmed in chat):
- Order (binding): §1 → §2 (user: Terraform) → §3 (user: the eight HMAC keys) → §4 (staging Keeper root, refusing a non-empty one; the CHI born locked; grant probe) → §5 (GCS mechanics; stop unless every row passes and the measured delete right equals `P1_BACKUP_DELETE`) → §6 (`si_backup` on indexer-b, indexer-c, then the network CHI, one installation per window, pod UIDs and restart counts unchanged) → §7 (the drill table, irreversible) → §8 (per owner b, c, a: one single-service commit setting `siBackup.enabled: true` and `DEVNET2_SI_BACKUP`, sync of that release only, the host StatefulSet unchanged, the first run by hand, a `full` index) → §9 (a second run per owner: `incr`, `base` = the first, `chain_length` 2) → §10 (one drill per owner b, c, a against the newest checked backup of §8–§9, named explicitly by `--backup`: `pass`) → §11 (the monitoring commit listing the three CronJobs and `DEVNET2_MONITORED_BACKUPS`; the alerts present and silent) → §12 (end record) → §13 (staging cleanup).
- Exit (spec §16 P1): every owner has a full and an incremental backup in the bucket whose index names a published manifest, and one restore drill per owner passes against it; `P1_MECHANICS` is recorded; the alerts are deployed; no SI ClickHouse, host pod, verifier or voter restarted during P1.
- Runbook names: `si_backup="$HOME/si-devnet2-stage3-p1"` (mode 700, created fresh); `si_p1_logins_dir="$HOME/si-devnet2-stage3-p1-logins"` (the user's hashes and access-id files; read only); helpers, all in §0's first bash block (D20), after the §0 helpers of the dynamic-table-set, multi-source, multi-source-tracks, stage3-p0, stage3-lockdown and stage3-indexer-c runbooks in that order: `si_p1_image` (prints `ghcr.io/sentioxyz/sentio-node:sha-<SN_COMMIT_P1>@<SN_DIGEST_P1>` from `$si_backup/pins`), `si_p1s_ch <sql>` (`clickhouse-client` as `default` over loopback in `storage-integrity-si-v2-p1-staging-source-0-0-0`, the password piped from `storage-integrity-si-v2-p1-staging-logins` key `default` into `kubectl exec -i` stdin), `si_s3_sql <account> <sql-file>` (runs the file's SQL as `default` on the P1 staging installation only — no live owner ClickHouse ever receives a key from the runbook; the Secret `storage-integrity-si-v2-<account>`'s `access-id` and `secret` and `default`'s password are piped on stdin and substituted for `@@S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID@@` and `@@S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY@@` inside the pod; nothing on argv or printed), `si_p1s_grant_probe` (Plan S3-B's grant-probe corpus, with this plan's rows, run against the P1 staging installation as `si_grant_probe` runs it, each role's password piped from `storage-integrity-si-v2-p1-staging-logins`; output `$si_backup/staging-grant-probe.tsv`), `si_index <a|b|c> <name>` (one index object, read on the staging installation with the `restore-drill` key, as JSON), `si_host_pods <a|b|c>` (UID, restart count and start time of the host pod and of its source ClickHouse pod), `si_backup_run <a|b|c> <n>` (mutating: `kubectl create job --from=cronjob/sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-<x>-si-backup sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-<x>-si-backup-p1-<n>`, waits, saves its stdout to `$si_backup/backup-<x>-<n>.json`), `si_drill <a|b|c>` (mutating: ConfigMap `si-p1-drill-config-<x>` and Job `si-p1-drill-<x>` running `/sentio-node storage-integrity restore-drill --config-path /etc/si-drill/config.yaml --owner <id> --owner-rpc <url> --backup <name of the newest checked backup-<x>-<n>.json>` on `si_p1_image`, `clickhouse_dsn: storage-integrity-si-v2-p1-staging-source:9000`, `clickhouse_username: si_restore`, `scratch_prefix: p1drill_<x>_`, env from `storage-integrity-si-v2-p1-staging-logins` key `si_restore` and `storage-integrity-si-v2-restore-drill`; saves its stdout to `$si_backup/drill-<x>.json`).

The ledger tool `$HOME/.cache/s3-ledger/s3-ledger.py` (contract §19, decision D23 generalized), verbatim:

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""The release ledger of the stage-3 plans: Appendix C of every plan file on housegate (Plan S3-C1 contract §19).

  s3-ledger.py plans HOUSEGATE
  s3-ledger.py ref HOUSEGATE PLAN
  s3-ledger.py show HOUSEGATE PLAN
  s3-ledger.py get HOUSEGATE NAME...
  s3-ledger.py empty HOUSEGATE NAME...
  s3-ledger.py set PLAN_FILE TASK RECORD_FILE NAME=VALUE...

HOUSEGATE is a housegate clone whose origin the caller fetched just before.
A plan file is docs/superpowers/plans/*-multi-source-si-s3*-*.md whose word
after "multi-source-si-" is a plan key (KEY: s3, one letter, optional digits:
s3a, s3b, s3c1, ..., s3f), and PLAN is that key; the glob's other files (the
s3cf status, scoping and names index) are not plans. A plan's ledger copy is
the first of REFS that holds its file; never a local checkout or a pending
PR. plans lists every plan with its ledger copy, its
file and its Appendix C names. ref prints a plan's ledger copy; show prints
its file as that copy holds it. get prints NAME=VALUE for every NAME, read on
the ledger copy of the one plan whose Appendix C defines it, and stops unless
each is recorded and well formed; empty stops unless each NAME's row is there
and empty. plans, get and empty stop when a key has two files or a name is a
row of two plan files. set fills, in PLAN_FILE (a plan file in a checkout of
its ledger copy), every row recorded by Task TASK, each named once as
NAME=VALUE, with `VALUE`, and Task TASK's run-record item with RECORD_FILE
(one paragraph, then optional lines starting "- ", which become its
sub-items); it refuses a row or an item that is missing, repeated or already
recorded, and a name that another plan file of the checkout defines, and
writes nothing then.

A row is | `NAME` | value | Task N |; its value is the first backquoted token
of the value cell (a Plan S3-A row without backquotes: its first word). A
value is well formed when it matches its name's pattern: EXACT, else the first
of SUFFIXES that ends the name once a phase suffix _P1 .. _P6 is removed,
else TOKEN.
"""

import fnmatch
import re
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

REL = "docs/superpowers/plans/"
GLOB = "*-multi-source-si-s3*-*.md"
KEY = re.compile(r"-multi-source-si-(s3[a-z][0-9]*)-")
REFS = ("origin/main", "origin/urwt/claude/ms-si-stage3-plans", "origin/urwt/claude/ms-si-stage3-plans-cf")
TAG = r"v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+"
DIGEST = r"sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}"
COMMIT = r"[0-9a-f]{40}"
PR = r"[1-9][0-9]*"
DATE = r"20[0-9]{2}-[01][0-9]-[0-3][0-9]"
UINT = r"[0-9]+"
NODE = r"[a-z0-9]([-a-z0-9.]*[a-z0-9])?"
ADDRESS = r"0x[0-9a-f]{40}"
TOKEN = r"[A-Za-z0-9/][A-Za-z0-9._:/=,+@-]{0,199}"
EXACT = {"OPERATOR_CHART_VERSION": r"[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+", "ARBITER_PIN_P2": COMMIT}
SUFFIXES = (
    ("_TAG", TAG), ("_DIGEST", DIGEST), ("_COMMIT", COMMIT), ("_PR", PR), ("_END", DATE),
    ("_EPOCH", UINT), ("_ID", UINT), ("_BLOCK", UINT), ("_NODE", NODE), ("_SIGNER", ADDRESS),
)
PHASE = re.compile(r"_P[1-6]$")
ROW = re.compile(r"^\|\s*`([A-Z0-9_]+)`\s*\|", re.M)


def fail(message):
    sys.exit(f"s3-ledger: {message}; stop")


def pattern(name):
    if name in EXACT:
        return EXACT[name]
    base = PHASE.sub("", name)
    for suffix, pat in SUFFIXES:
        if base.endswith(suffix):
            return pat
    return TOKEN


def plan_key(path):
    name = Path(path).name
    found = KEY.search(name)
    if not fnmatch.fnmatch(name, GLOB) or not found:
        return None
    return found.group(1)


def git(hg, *args):
    out = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", hg, *args], capture_output=True, text=True)
    return out.stdout if out.returncode == 0 else None


def discover(hg):
    plans = {}
    for ref in REFS:
        listing = git(hg, "ls-tree", "--name-only", ref, REL)
        if listing is None:
            continue
        for path in listing.split():
            key = plan_key(path)
            if key is None:
                continue
            if key in plans and plans[key][0] != path:
                fail(f"plan {key} is {plans[key][0]} on {plans[key][1]} but {path} on {ref}")
            plans.setdefault(key, (path, ref))
    if not plans:
        fail(f"none of {', '.join(REFS)} of {hg} holds a plan file {REL}{GLOB} (fetch origin first)")
    return plans


def appendix(text, where, strict):
    heads = list(re.finditer(r"^## Appendix C\b.*$", text, re.M))
    if not heads and not strict:
        return None
    if len(heads) != 1:
        fail(f"{where}: expected one '## Appendix C' heading, found {len(heads)}")
    start = heads[0].end()
    nxt = re.search(r"^## ", text[start:], re.M)
    end = start + nxt.start() if nxt else len(text)
    return text[:start], text[start:end], text[end:]


def names(section):
    return [m.group(1) for m in ROW.finditer(section)]


def row(section, name, where):
    found = list(re.finditer(r"^\|\s*`%s`\s*\|(.*)$" % re.escape(name), section, re.M))
    if len(found) != 1:
        fail(f"{where}: expected one Appendix C row for {name}, found {len(found)}")
    cells = [cell.strip() for cell in found[0].group(1).rstrip().rstrip("|").split("|")]
    if len(cells) != 2 or not re.fullmatch(r"Task [0-9]+", cells[1]):
        fail(f"{where}: the {name} row is not | `{name}` | value | Task N |")
    return found[0], cells[0], cells[1]


def value(cell, name, key, where):
    quoted = re.search(r"`([^`]*)`", cell)
    if quoted:
        token = quoted.group(1)
    else:
        token = cell.split()[0] if key == "s3a" and cell.split() else ""
    if not token:
        fail(f"{where}: {name} is not recorded")
    if not re.fullmatch(pattern(name), token):
        fail(f"{where}: {name} is {token!r}, not {pattern(name)}")
    return token


def catalogue(hg):
    plans = discover(hg)
    sections, owner = {}, {}
    for key, (path, ref) in sorted(plans.items()):
        where = f"{ref}:{path}"
        text = git(hg, "show", f"{ref}:{path}")
        if text is None:
            fail(f"{where} cannot be read")
        parts = appendix(text, where, strict=False)
        sections[key] = (where, parts[1] if parts else "")
        for name in names(sections[key][1]):
            if owner.get(name, key) != key:
                fail(f"{name} is a row of both Plan {owner[name]} and Plan {key}: a ledger name is defined once")
            owner[name] = key
    return plans, sections, owner


def lookup(hg, wanted):
    if not wanted:
        fail("no NAME given")
    _, sections, owner = catalogue(hg)
    unknown = [name for name in wanted if name not in owner]
    if unknown:
        fail(f"not a row of any plan's Appendix C: {unknown}")
    for name in wanted:
        key = owner[name]
        where, section = sections[key]
        _, cell, _ = row(section, name, where)
        yield name, key, where, cell


def get(hg, wanted):
    for name, key, where, cell in list(lookup(hg, wanted)):
        print(f"{name}={value(cell, name, key, where)}")


def empty(hg, wanted):
    places = set()
    for name, _, where, cell in list(lookup(hg, wanted)):
        if cell:
            fail(f"{where}: {name} is recorded already ({cell!r}): its task ran before")
        places.add(where)
    print(f"s3-ledger: {' '.join(wanted)} not recorded yet in {', '.join(sorted(places))}")


def plan_ref(hg, key):
    plans = discover(hg)
    if key not in plans:
        fail(f"no plan {key!r} on {', '.join(REFS)}; plans: {', '.join(sorted(plans))}")
    return plans[key]


def list_plans(hg):
    plans, sections, _ = catalogue(hg)
    for key in sorted(plans):
        path, ref = plans[key]
        print(f"{key} {ref} {path} {','.join(names(sections[key][1])) or '-'}")


def set_values(plan_file, task, record_file, pairs):
    plan = Path(plan_file)
    if plan_key(plan) is None:
        fail(f"{plan_file} is not a plan file {GLOB}")
    if not re.fullmatch(r"[1-9][0-9]*", task):
        fail(f"TASK {task!r} is not a task number")
    values = {}
    for pair in pairs:
        name, sep, val = pair.partition("=")
        if not sep or not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Z0-9_]+", name) or name in values:
            fail(f"{pair!r} is not one NAME=VALUE")
        if not re.fullmatch(pattern(name), val):
            fail(f"{name}={val!r} does not match {pattern(name)}")
        values[name] = val
    for path in (plan, Path(record_file)):
        if not path.is_file():
            fail(f"{path} does not exist")
    lines = Path(record_file).read_text().strip().split("\n")
    first = next((i for i, line in enumerate(lines) if line.startswith("- ")), len(lines))
    paragraph = " ".join(" ".join(lines[:first]).split())
    subitems = [" ".join(line[2:].split()) for line in lines[first:] if line.strip()]
    if (not paragraph or any(not line.strip() for line in lines[:first])
            or any(not line.startswith("- ") for line in lines[first:] if line.strip()) or "" in subitems):
        fail(f"{record_file}: expected one paragraph, then only lines starting '- '")
    text = plan.read_text()
    head, section, tail = appendix(text, plan_file, strict=True)
    ours = sorted(m.group(1) for m in re.finditer(r"^\|\s*`([A-Z0-9_]+)`\s*\|[^\n]*\|\s*Task %s\s*\|\s*$" % task, section, re.M))
    if not ours:
        fail(f"{plan_file}: no Appendix C row is recorded by Task {task}")
    if ours != sorted(values):
        fail(f"{plan_file}: Task {task} records {ours} in Appendix C; give exactly those, once each")
    for other in sorted(plan.parent.glob(GLOB)):
        if other.resolve() == plan.resolve() or plan_key(other) is None:
            continue
        parts = appendix(other.read_text(), str(other), strict=False)
        clash = sorted(set(values) & set(names(parts[1]))) if parts else []
        if clash:
            fail(f"{other} also defines {clash}: a ledger name is defined once")
    for name, val in values.items():
        match, cell, by = row(section, name, plan_file)
        if cell:
            fail(f"{plan_file}: {name} is recorded already ({cell!r}); Appendix C is never edited afterwards")
        section = section[:match.start()] + f"| `{name}` | `{val}` | {by} |" + section[match.end():]
    items = list(re.finditer(r"^- (.+?) \(Task %s\):(.*)$" % task, section, re.M))
    if len(items) != 1 or items[0].group(2).strip():
        fail(f"{plan_file}: expected one empty run-record item '- <record> (Task {task}):', found {len(items)}"
             + (f" ({items[0].group(0)!r})" if items else ""))
    item = items[0]
    if re.match(r"\n {2,}- ", section[item.end():]):
        fail(f"{plan_file}: the run-record item of Task {task} has sub-items already")
    filled = f"- {item.group(1)} (Task {task}): {paragraph}" + "".join(f"\n  - {sub}" for sub in subitems)
    section = section[:item.start()] + filled + section[item.end():]
    plan.write_text(head + section + tail)
    print(f"s3-ledger: Task {task} recorded " + ", ".join(f"{n}={v}" for n, v in values.items())
          + f" and its run record '{item.group(1)}' in {plan_file}")


def main(args):
    if len(args) == 2 and args[0] == "plans":
        list_plans(args[1])
    elif len(args) == 3 and args[0] == "ref":
        print(plan_ref(args[1], args[2])[1])
    elif len(args) == 3 and args[0] == "show":
        path, ref = plan_ref(args[1], args[2])
        text = git(args[1], "show", f"{ref}:{path}")
        if text is None:
            fail(f"{ref}:{path} cannot be read")
        print(text, end="")
    elif len(args) >= 3 and args[0] == "get":
        get(args[1], args[2:])
    elif len(args) >= 3 and args[0] == "empty":
        empty(args[1], args[2:])
    elif len(args) >= 5 and args[0] == "set":
        set_values(args[1], args[2], args[3], args[4:])
    else:
        sys.exit(__doc__)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main(sys.argv[1:])
```
